usage.on.p1.html: Uhlelo lwakho lunemikhawulo emibili: owodwa ngeseshini yamahora ama-5 nowodwa ngesonto. Alukho umkhawulo wenyanga. Amagejikhaya amabili amakhulu e-"% esele" avela lapha ngokushesha nje lapho kufika ukufundwa kokuqala.
usage.on.p2.html: Ukuze uyithole: qala iseshini entsha (amaseshini ayevele evuliwe awayithathi). Uma kungabonakali lutho emzuzwini, qala eyodwa ku-terminal esikhundleni (thayipha umyalo ojwayelekile kunoma iyiphi i-folda yephrojekthi), ngoba iphaneli ye-VS Code ingase ingathumeli ukufundwa.

usage.off.p1.html: Uhlelo lwakho lunemikhawulo emibili: owodwa ngeseshini yamahora ama-5 nowodwa ngesonto. Alukho umkhawulo wenyanga. Uma sekuvuliwe, amagejikhaya amabili amakhulu lapha abonisa % esele ngalinye, nokuthi liphinde lisethwe nini.
usage.off.step.html: Isinyathelo esisodwa: vula i-{file} ku-Notepad, namathisela lemigqa kulayini omusha ngemva kwe-{ yokuqala, bese ugcina.
usage.off.chat.html: Noma utshele umholi engxoxweni: "yebo, engeza umugqa wesimo ezilungiselelweni zami ezijwayelekile".
usage.off.fill: Amagejikhaya agcwala ngesikhathi esilandelayo lapho kusebenza noma iyiphi iseshini yesikhulumeli.
usage.where.html: Inombolo yohlelo ivela kuphela eseshini yesikhulumeli efasiteleni le-terminal; i-VS Code nokusebenza ngemuva akuyibikeli. Ukusetshenziswa kwama-token ngephrojekthi (ngezansi) kuhlala kuphila.

usage.line.explain: Lapho umugqa uphakama, kusetshenziswe kakhulu uhlelo lwakho. Ku-100% uphelelwe kuze kube lusethwa kabusha.
usage.headline.none: Akukho msebenzi wesikhulumeli orekhodiwe ezinsukwini ezingu-30 zokugcina.
usage.bars.aria: Ishadi lezinsika eziqoqwe: ukusetshenziswa kwansuku zonke ezinsukwini ezingu-30 zokugcina, kuhlukaniswe ngephrojekthi. Sebenzisa imicibisholo yesobunxele nesokudla ukufunda usuku ngalunye.
usage.runs.explain: Okusetshenziswe ukusebenza ngakunye kweqembu, okukhulu kuqala. Okufakiwe kuhlanganisa umongo omusha obhalwe kukhashi; ukufundwa kwekhashi kungumongo ofundwa futhi, oshibhile.
usage.runs.total: Okukhonjiswe ngezansi: ukusebenza okungu-{n}, {in} okungenayo, {out} okuphumayo, {cache} ukufundwa kwekhashi (umongo ofundwa futhi, ingxenye enkulu yezindleko).
usage.rank.explain: Iphrojekthi esebenza kakhulu iphezulu. Insika ibonisa izinsuku ezi-7 zokugcina.
usage.bars.explain: Insika ngayinye isuku elilodwa kwangu-30 zokugcina. Ende isho ukuthi izikhulumeli zenze umsebenzi omningi ngalolo suku. Umsebenzi ubalwa ngama-token, izingcezu ezincane zombhalo ezifundwa futhi zibhalwe izikhulumeli.
usage.nologs: Khomba ibhodi ku-folda yamarekhodi amaseshini esikhulumeli sakho ukubona ukuthi yimaphi amaphrojekthi asebenzisa kakhulu.

gloss.standup.text: Ukubheka okusheshayo kwansuku zonke: ilungu ngalinye leqembu lenzeni, lenzani ngokulandelayo, nokuthi yini ebamisayo. Ku-Scrum kubizwa ngokuthi daily scrum.
gloss.bug.text: Into engasebenzi ngendlela okufanele isebenze ngayo.
gloss.test.text: Ukuhlola ukuthi into isebenza ngendlela okufanele yini. Ezinye izivivinyo ikhompyutha iziqhuba yodwa njalo uma ikhodi ishintsha; ezinye wukuzama kwakho ikhadi eliqediwe ngaphambi kokuba ulamukele.
gloss.commit.text: Isithombe esigciniwe sekhodi, esinenothi elifushane lokushintshile. Ungabuyela kunye noma nini.
gloss.push.text: Ukuthumela izithombe zakho ezigciniwe (ama-commit) kusuka kukhompyutha yakho kuya ekhophini ebelwanayo ku-inthanethi, njenge-GitHub, ukuze zigcinwe ngokuphepha futhi abanye bazithole.
gloss.branch.text: Umugqa ohlukile womsebenzi ekhodini, ukuze izinguquko zenziwe ngaphandle kokuthinta inguqulo eyinhloko.
gloss.merge.text: Ukuhlanganisa izinguquko ezivela egatsheni elilodwa kolunye, imvamisa kubuyele enguqulweni eyinhloko.
gloss.repo.text: Ifolda yephrojekthi yekhodi nomlando wayo ophelele wama-commit. Ingahlala kukhompyutha yakho, ku-GitHub, noma kokubili.
gloss.refactor.text: Ukuhlela ikhodi ngaphandle kokushintsha okwenzayo: amafayela amancane, amagama acacile, ukuphindaphinda okuncane.
gloss.deploy.text: Ukukopisha inguqulo entsha yesofthiwe emakhompyutheni ayisebenzisayo, njengekhophi yokuhlola noma isevisi ephilayo.
gloss.kanban.text: Indlela yokusebenza lapho amakhadi ehamba phakathi kwezingqimba zebhodi (njengo-Okufanele kwenziwe, Kuyaqhubeka, Kuphelile) futhi iqembu likhawulela ukuthi kungakanani okuqhubekayo ngesikhathi esisodwa, ukuze umsebenzi uqhubeke ugeleza.
gloss.wip.text: I-WIP isifinyezo se-work in progress (umsebenzi oqhubekayo). Umkhawulo we-WIP yinani eliphezulu lamakhadi isingqimba okufanele sibambe ngesikhathi esisodwa, ukuze iqembu liqede izinto ngaphambi kokuqala ezengeziwe.
gloss.pr.text: Ukucela ukuthi izinguquko zegatsha zihlolwe futhi zihlanganiswe enguqulweni eyinhloko. Ezinye izindawo zikubiza ngokuthi merge request.
gloss.hook.text: Umyalo omncane osebenza wodwa ngesikhathi esimisiwe, isibonelo uma iseshini ye-AI iqala, ukuze iqembu lizwe amakhomenti akho.
gloss.token.text: Izingcezu ezincane zombhalo i-AI ezifundayo nezibhalayo, cishe izingxenye ezintathu kwezine zegama ngayinye. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI kubalwa ngama-token, ngakho ama-token ambalwa ashiya okuningi kohlelo lwakho.
gloss.agent.text: I-AI esebenza emsebenzini yodwa: ifunda ikhodi, yenza izinguquko, iqhuba ukuhlola, ibike emuva. Umsebenzi wayo usahlolwa nokho.
tour.btn.title: Uhambo olufushane oluholwayo lwebhodi
tour.lvl.new.help: Konke ukuma, nokuthi kungani kusebenza kanje. Amagama ochwepheshe achazwa nawo.
tour.welcome.title: Siyakwamukela ku-AI-gile
tour.welcome.text: Ibhodi lapho amaqembu e-AI enza umsebenzi futhi wena unquma, uhlola futhi wamukele. Nansi indlela yokuzazi.
tour.welcome.why: Umcabango: amaqembu enza umsebenzi omncane, wena ubona kuphela okudinga umuntu.
tour.rail.title: Amaphrojekthi akho
tour.rail.text: Ikhaya, ibhokisi lakho elingenayo, izingxoxo nabaholi, bese uphawu olulodwa ngephrojekthi. I-diamondi ephephuli ibonisa ukuthi kukhona okukulindele lapho. Hudula izithonjana uzibeke ngokuhleleka kwakho.
tour.rail.short: Amaphrojekthi ku-rail (ngaphansi efonini); amadayimane aphephuli asho ukuthi okuthile kulindele wena.
tour.rail.why: Ukubuka kanye kukutshela lapho udingeka khona, ngaphandle kokuvula lutho.
tour.inbox.title: Ibhokisi lakho elingenayo
tour.inbox.text: Konke okulindele wena, kuwo wonke amaphrojekthi: imibuzo, imisebenzi engenziwa wena kuphela, nezinto zokuhlola. Chofoza ishipu ukubona uhlobo olulodwa kuphela.
tour.inbox.short: Konke okulindele wena, yonke indawo. Chofoza ishipu ukuthola uhlobo olulodwa.
tour.inbox.why: Akufanele uvakashele ngalinye iphrojekthi ukuze wazi ukuthi yini ekudingayo.
tour.foryou.title: Kuwe
tour.foryou.text: Ebhodini, lesi singqimba sibamba okulindele wena kuleyo phrojekthi. Vula umhlolo, landela izinyathelo zawo, bese Wamukela noma Ubuyisela ngesizathu.
tour.foryou.short: Inqwaba yale phrojekthi kuwe: hlola, bese Wamukela noma Ubuyisela.
tour.foryou.why: Amaqembu awawamaki umsebenzi wawo njengophelile: wena uyawamukela. Lokho kugcina ikhwalithi ezandleni zakho.
tour.chat.title: Xoxa nabaholi
tour.chat.text: Thumela umholi wephrojekthi umlayezo onomcabango noma umbuzo. Bashintsha imibono ibe amakhadi nohlelo olufushane, namabhutoni we-Go akho.
tour.chat.short: Thumela umholi umlayezo; uyakuhlela bese wena uchofoza i-Go.
tour.chat.why: Akukho okwakhiwayo kuze kube usho ukuthi hamba: wena ugcina ukuphatha okwenzekayo.
tour.setup.title: Ukusetha
tour.setup.text: Igama lakho, ulimi, itimu nalapho i-AI ihlala khona kule khompyutha. Kukhona nesishintshi sokuchaza amagama abathuthukisi, kanye nohlu lwamagama.
tour.setup.short: Izilungiselelo zakho, ulimi nohlu lwamagama abathuthukisi. Efonini itholakala kumenyu ephezulu.
trial.help: Ikhophi entsha ngokuphelele nengenalutho ye-AI-gile efasiteleni layo (localhost:4400), enamaphrojekthi amathathu akhiwe ukuze uwathole neqembu lokulingisa eliphendula wena. Bona ncamashi lokho umngani akubona ekusebenzeni kwakhe kokuqala. Ibhodi lakho langempela alithintwa; ayikho i-AI, akukho nkokhelo.
standup.needs: 🙋 Kudinga wena ({n}): amaqembu aqhubeka ngalesi sikhathi
quiet.until.help: Ngalesi sikhathi uyabuya ekuthuleni wedwa, futhi isifinyezo siyalinda.
watch.help: Ngenkathi ungekho uhlola lamaphrojekthi njalo ngemizuzu eyi-10: uvusa amaqembu anomsebenzi, aqalise kabusha lawo ame phakathi nekhadi, amake ikhadi njengelibambekile ngemuva kwemizamo emi-3. Akukhokhelwa lutho: ibhodi lingenza lokhu, hhayi i-AI.
restart.title: Izici ezintsha zidinga i-AI-gile iqalwe kabusha ukuze zisebenze. Ilayisha leli khasi futhi. Ithatha imizuzwana embalwa; ilinda uma iqembu lixakekile.
quiet.done.sub: Amaqembu aqhubeka; uthola isifinyezo uma ubuya.
quiet.done.none: Alikho iqembu elinomsebenzi ovulekile, ngakho akekho owayedinga ukutshelwa.
ng.calm: Konke kuthule. Akukho okukudingayo namuhla ebusuku.
ng.open.title: Ifasitele elincane, elithulile lesikrini sesibili: umlindi ngokubuka kanye
quiz.sub: Ukukhetha okusheshayo okuyisithupha. Ngamunye ushintsha isilungiselelo; ungashintsha noma imuphi ngesandla kamuva ku-Setup.
quiz.tidy: Amakhadi akho aphuma ngokushesha futhi ewumxakaniso?
quiz.chatty.chatty: 💬 Ukhuluma kakhulu: ukukhumbuza okuncane noma uhlaya olulula
quiz.chatty.all: Futhi kumaphrojekthi anginawo manje (hhayi amasha kuphela)
quiz.go: Buza ngaphambi kokwakha ngakunye, noma qhubeka ngezinto ezincane?
quiz.night.work: Cha: umlindi we-🌙 ugcina amaqembu esebenza
quiz.steps: Uma wenza okuthile ngesandla (umyalo weseva, ukusetha), izinyathelo ezingaki ngesikhathi?
quiz.steps.one: Isinyathelo esisodwa ngesikhathi: linda kuze kube ngithi kuphelile
quiz.saved: ✅ Kugciniwe. Shintsha noma yini ngezansi ngesandla.
quiz.help: Imibuzo eyisithupha esheshayo ehambisa izilayidi ngezansi. Yenze futhi noma nini.
steps.1: Isinyathelo esisodwa, sho engifanele ngikubone, linda "kuphelile"
steps.2: Izinyathelo ezimbili noma ezintathu, bese uyalinda
steps.4: Lonke umsebenzi njengohlu olunezinombolo, hlola ekugcineni
lead.tech.help: Ukuthi iqembu libeka imininingwane engakanani ezinyathelweni zeseva nezokusetha.
lead.watchAll.help: Uma uthula, wonke amaphrojekthi ayamakwa ukuze alinde umlindi wasebusuku. Kuvaliwe: awekho amakiwe, ngakho ubusuku buhlala bukuthula.
lead.light.help: Ukuphendula amakhomenti akho kusebenzisa imodeli encane, futhi ukusebenza kwesi-5 ngakunye kuqala ingxoxo entsha esikhundleni sokuphatha ende. Ukwakha kwasebusuku kugcina imodeli enkulu. Kuhle ezinhlelweni ze-Pro.
face.me.help: I-PNG, i-JPG, i-SVG, i-ICO noma i-WEBP, kufika ku-1 MB. Kukhonjiswa eduze kwemilayezo namakhomenti akho.
face.lib.help: Faka izithombe (png, jpg, svg, webp, gif) ku-{dir}. Isikhulumeli ngasinye sithatha esisodwa ngesikhathi sokuqala sijoyina iqembu, futhi singasishintsha nge-aigile avatar.

tester.title: Umhloli we-AI ulandela izinyathelo zomhlolo futhi amake ikhadi ngalinye 🤖 liphumelele, lehlulekile noma liyeqiwe. Wena usasamukela.
tester.started: Umhloli we-AI uqalile: imiphumela ivela njengamashipu e-🤖
fy.tester.title: Ngihloleleni lokhu: umhloli we-AI ulandela izinyathelo zemihlolo engu-{n} elinde lapha. Wena usasamukela.

share.btn.title: Xhuma le phrojekthi nephrojekthi yomngani, ukuze nishintshane ngamakhadi namakhomenti
share.intro: Amakhadi owamake nge-🔗 kuphela adlula: ayikho ikhodi, amafayela, izifolda, izilungiselelo noma amanye amakhadi. Umngani wakho kumele amukele.

share.never: Umbhalo womngani awusoze wavusa iqembu lakho futhi awubalwa njengowakho.
share.allow.teamRead: Vumela iqembu lami ukuthi lifunde amakhadi abo

share.switch.off: Kuvaliwe: akukho okuthunyelwayo, futhi noma yini efikayo ilahlwa ingagcinwanga.
share.forget.confirm: Qeda isixhumanisi ususe amakhadi abo namakhomenti ebhodini lakho? Amakhadi akho ayahlala.

join.send: Thumela lesi sixhumanisi kumngani wakho (WhatsApp, umlayezo omfushane). Sisebenza kanye.
join.noStatus: Asikwazanga ukubuza isevisi yokujoyina ukuthi yiziphi izixhumanisi ezisetshenzisiwe.
join.key: Ukhiye wakho, weseva (JOIN_OWNER_KEY). Lolu khiye kuphela olungangeza izixhumanisi.
dmf.add.help: Umngani wakho ukuthumelele ikhodi? Yinamathisele lapha umnike igama.
dmf.add.name: Igama lakhe
dmf.added: U-{name} wengeziwe. Manje qhathanisa amagama okuphepha ngezansi.

share.held: ⏸ Akuthunyelwanga ku-{name}: kubonakala njengendlela noma imfihlo.
share.fc.takehelp: Ukuyithatha kuyenza ibe ikhadi lakho. Iqembu lakho liyibona kuphela uma uyisusa ku-Backlog.
share.fc.plain: Kukhonjiswa njengombhalo olula: izixhumanisi ekhadini lomngani azichofozeki.
share.files.note: Agcinwa kukhompyutha yakho uma uchofoza: ibhodi alikaze liwavule noma liwabonise. Vula kuphela lokho obukulindele.

Ukuchofoza kanye kuqala ibhodi lesibili lomngani wokulingisa, u-{name} (idatha yakhe, izihluthulelo nefasitele), ne-relay encane yayo, ngakho akukho seva edingekayo. Abangani bakho bangempela nezihluthulelo azithintwa. Ngenkathi isebenza, ama-DM akho adlula ku-relay yendawo; abuyela emuva uma uyeka.

pretend.started.manual: U-{name} uyasebenza. Zijwayeze isimemo: thola ikhodi ka-{name} ngezansi uyinamathisele ku-Engeza umngani, noma mema u-{name} ohlangothini lwakho uyinamathisele ebhodini lakhe.

pretend.keep.q: Yeka u-{name}. Gcina idatha yakhe kolunye usuku?
pretend.stopped: Kumisiwe. Umngani wokulingisa akasekho ohlwini lwabangani bakho futhi izilungiselelo zakho ze-DM zibuyile.
pretend.kept: Idatha ka-Davy yesikhathi esedlule igciniwe futhi izosetshenziswa futhi.
budget.usage.help: Ukuhlola kubuza i-AI umbuzo owodwa omncane ukufunda ukusetshenziswa kohlelo lwakho, ngakho ngamunye ubiza kancane. Ngesandla: inkinobho Hlola ukusetshenziswa manje ekhasini Lokusetshenziswa. Ngokuzenzakalelayo futhi kuhlola uma ukufundwa kokugcina kudlule ihora. Kuvaliwe: akukho nkinobho futhi akukho kuhlola.
budget.h5: Ungavusi amaqembu ngaphezu kwale % yomkhawulo wamahora ama-5
budget.wk: Ungavusi amaqembu ngaphezu kwale % yomkhawulo wesonto
budget.help: Isebenzisa ukufundwa kokugcina kokusetshenziswa. Ngaphezu kwanoma yiliphi inani akukho okuqalayo (amaqembu, umlindi wasebusuku, umhloli we-AI, imibuzo yabangani) kuze kwehle ukusetshenziswa noma kusethwe kabusha.
budget.runs: Ukusebenza kweqembu okuningi ngesikhathi esisodwa (0 = akukho mkhawulo)
budget.runs.help: Ukuvusa okwengeziwe kuhlala emgqeni futhi kuqala lapho ukusebenza kuphela.
budget.helpers.help: Kwengezwa embhalweni womholi njengomthetho: sebenzisa abasizi abangaphezulu kwalesi sibalo bemodeli ngayinye ngesikhathi esisodwa.
budget.pace: Isivinini: hlosa ukuqeda isonto cishe ku-{pct}%. Uma isibikezelo sithi uzodlula lokho ngaphambi kokusetha kabusha, ibhodi liyehlisa isivinini (akukho basizi abengeziwe, amamodeli amancane) bese likutshela kanye.
nt.title.off: Misa konke ukusetshenziswa kwe-AI ngesikhathi esisodwa: amaqembu asebenzayo, umhloli we-AI, buza umngani nokuhlola ukusetshenziswa. Ibhodi liqhubeka nokusebenzela wena.
nt.title.on: Imodi Yokungasebenzisi Ama-token ivuliwe: akukho okwe-AI okusebenzayo noma okuqalayo. Chofoza ukuvula i-AI futhi.
nt.title.limit: Umkhawulo wokusetshenziswa kohlelo ufinyelelwe, ngakho Imodi Yokungasebenzisi Ama-token ivulwe yodwa. Chofoza ukuvula i-AI futhi.
nt.title.back: Ukusetshenziswa kwakho kubuyile. Chofoza ukuvula i-AI futhi (ayivuleki yodwa).
dispatch.help: Amakhomenti akho namakhadi amasha aya komholi ngaphandle kokuthi umbize omunye (@Igama) noma ikhadi ngumhlolo. Imithetho kuphela ayibizi i-AI neze; Imithetho + Haiku ibuza imodeli encane kanye uma imithetho ingakwazi ukuhlukanisa; Umholi unquma uvusa umholi njalo. Isinqumo ngasinye siphawulwa kurekhodi lephrojekthi.
wz.btn.help: Umzuzu wemibuzo elungisa i-AI-gile kusabelomali sakho nendlela yakho yokusebenza. Konke kuyashintshwa ngezansi.
wz.ask.sub: Ufuna isiluleki esisheshayo sokusetha izinto? Silungisa i-AI-gile kusabelomali sakho nendlela yakho yokusebenza, sithatha cishe umzuzu. Noma ungazitholela indlela yakho.
wz.need.name: Engeza igama lakho kuqala, ukuze iqembu lazi ukuthi likubize ngani.
wz.1.sub: Ku-AI-gile, abasizi be-AI basebenza emakhadini akho bese wena uhlola abakwenzile. Imibuzo embalwa esheshayo bese ulungile. Ulimi lwakho selukhethiwe kakade: lushintshe lapha uma lungalungile.
wz.2.name: Igama lakho
wz.2.agent.help: Uhlelo lwe-AI ibhodi eliluqalisa uma kunomsebenzi wabasizi bakho. Awuqiniseki? Lushiye lungenalutho bese ulwengeza ngemva kwesikhathi ku-Setup.
wz.3.h: Abasizi bakho be-AI kufanele basebenze kanjani nawe?
wz.3.sub: Khetha okusondele kakhulu. Ungashintsha ingxenye ngayinye yalo ngemva kwesikhathi ku-Setup.
wz.style.careful.help: Libuza ngaphambi kokwakha ngakunye, lithule futhi lihlelekile, liphumula ebusuku.
wz.style.balanced.help: Liqhubeka ngezinto ezincane, ukukhumbuza okuncane okunobungani, liphumula ebusuku.
wz.style.fast.help: Libuza kancane, umsebenzi nje, liqhubeka ebusuku.
wz.4.sub: Lokhu kusetha ukuthi ibhodi lingasebenzisa kangakanani kohlelo lwakho lwe-AI, nokuthi mangaki amaphrojekthi asetshenzwa ngesikhathi esisodwa. Awuqiniseki? Khetha “Okujwayelekile”.

help.start.p: I-AI-gile yibhodi lamaphrojekthi akho. Ngayinye iphrojekthi ineqembu elincane losizo lwe-AI: unika amakhadi, benza umsebenzi, wena uyawahlola.
help.start.1: Yenza iphrojekthi: ekhaya cindezela "+ Phrojekthi entsha", bhala igama bese ucindezela Dala.
help.start.2: Engeza ikhadi: vula iphrojekthi bese wengeza ikhadi elichaza ukuthi kudingeka kwenziwe ini. Iqembu liyalithatha.
help.start.3: Kuwe kuwuhlu lwakho siqu: izinto ezilinda impendulo yakho noma imvume yakho. Zibheke ngezikhathi ezithile.
help.start.4: Imilayezo (inkinobho ye-💬 eqaleni kwe-rail yangakwesobunxele) ikuvumela ukuthi uxoxe neqembu ngqo, noma ubuze umsizi wakho siqu.
help.start.more: Ufuna uhambo oluqondisiwe? Sebenzisa Hamba uhambo kule menyu, noma uzame imodi yedemo enamaphrojekthi okuzenzisa.

srv.major.nudgehint: {id}: umugqa wesimo uyadingeka. Engeza ukuphawula okuqala ngo-"Status:".
srv.major.ended: 🚨 Isigameko esikhulu siqediwe ngu-{by}. Ukuhlangana kuvaliwe uma leli khadi lilivulile.
srv.pir.order: 📝 KUDINGEKA UKUBUYEKEZWA: lesi sigameko esikhulu sesivaliwe. {name}, wawulindile: bhala ukubuyekezwa kwangemva kwesigameko. Ukuthumela: aigile pir {slug} {id} --timeline "kwenzekeni, ngokulandelana" --helped "okusize" --actions "shintsha okukodwa | shintsha okunye" --as {name}. Yenza kube mfushane; isenzo ngasinye kufanele sibe yinguquko eyodwa esingayenza.
srv.pir.hint: bhala ukubuyekezwa kwangemva kwesigameko se-{id} manje: aigile pir (bheka ukuphawula kwekhadi).
srv.pir.manual: Ukubuyekezwa: zibhalele wena. I-AI ivaliwe, ngakho akukho muntu obuziwe: ukulandelana kwezenzakalo, okusize, okufanele kushintshwe. Thumela nge: aigile pir {slug} {id} --timeline ".." --helped ".." --actions "okukodwa | okunye" --as NAME
pir.heading: 📝 Ukubuyekezwa kwangemva kwesigameko
srv.pir.rb.next: Ukubuyekezwa kuthunyelwe. {name}: manje phakamisa i-runbook ukuze kusheshe ngesikhathi esilandelayo: aigile pir-runbook {slug} {id} <short-name> --text "izinyathelo, ngayinye emgqeni" --as {name}. gloss.title: 📖 Amagama achaziwe
gloss.about: Ukuqeqeshwa mahhala ngolimi olulula: wonke igama ohlangana nalo kusukela embonweni wokuqala kuya enkonzweni abantu abayethembele kuyo, nge-Agile, ukwakha, ukuyigcina iphephile nokusebenza nge-AI endleleni.
gloss.about.noai: Ukuqeqeshwa mahhala ngolimi olulula: wonke igama ohlangana nalo kusukela embonweni wokuqala kuya enkonzweni abantu abayethembele kuyo, nge-Agile, ukwakha nokuyigcina iphephile endleleni.
gloss.card.text: Ucezu olulodwa lomsebenzi: umsebenzi, iphutha noma umbono. Lihamba phakathi kwezingqimba kuze kuphele.
gloss.project.text: Ibhodi lento eyodwa ofuna ukuyiqeda, njenge-app, ishede lengadi noma uhambo. Libamba amakhadi.
gloss.forteam.text: Isingqimba samakhadi asebuyele ezandleni zeqembu, isibonelo ngemva kokuba uphendule umbuzo walo noma ucele ushintsho.
gloss.lead.text: Umsizi we-AI obhekele iphrojekthi. Uthatha amakhadi akho, ahlukanisa umsebenzi, futhi akubuze uma ekudinga.
gloss.agentprog.text: Uhlelo lwe-AI kukhompyutha yakho, njenge-Claude Code, ibhodi eliluqalisa uma kunomsebenzi wabasizi bakho.
gloss.dispatcher.text: Ingxenye yebhodi efunda ikhadi elisha noma ikhomenti elisha bese inquma ukuthi ngubani ozolithatha. Kuqala kusetshenziswa imithetho elula, kusetshenziswe i-AI encane kuphela uma kungaqinisekile.
gloss.space.text: Iqoqo lamaphrojekthi ahlangene, njengefolda lamabhodi. I-🪐 iphawula elilodwa.
gloss.playground.text: Iphrojekthi eselungile yokuba umngani azame i-AI-gile kuyo, enekhodi yesimemo ongayithumela kuye.
gloss.hyperfocus.text: 🎯 Ibonisa iphrojekthi eyodwa nemilayezo yakho kuphela, ukuze kungabikho okunye okukudonsa. Amaqembu aqhubeka njengokujwayelekile.
gloss.qa.text: Isifinyezo se-quality assurance: konke okwenziwa ukuqinisekisa ukuthi umsebenzi ulungile ngaphambi kokuba uphile. Ku-AI-gile lokho kusho ukuhlolwa okuzenzakalelayo: uma i-QA ibomvu, okuthile kwehlulekile, futhi ayikwazi ukuphila kuze kulungiswe.
gloss.release.text: Iqoqo elinegama lomsebenzi oqediwe eliphila ndawonye, linamanothi amafushane ngokushintshile. 🚀 Ukukhishwa kubhala lawo manothi kusuka emakhadini aqediwe.
gloss.rollback.text: Ukubuyela enguqulweni yokugcina ebisebenza uma entsha idala inkinga. Ku-AI-gile, Roll back ihlanganisa izinyathelo zokuhoxisa ezibhalwe kushintsho ngalunye zibe uhlu olulodwa lokuhlola.
gloss.live.text: Inguqulo yangempela abantu abayisebenzisayo, hhayi ikhophi yokuzama izinto. Ukufaka okuthile lapho kubizwa ngokukuphilisa. Abathuthukisi bakubiza nangokuthi i-production.
gloss.change.text: Ushintsho oluhleliwe entweni abantu abathembele kuyo, olubhalwa kuqala: yini, kungani, ubungozi, nini, nokuthi lungahlehliswa kanjani. Qala ngokuthi 🔀 Phakamisa ushintsho.
gloss.risk.text: Okuthile okungahamba kabi, okulinganiswa ngokuthi kungenzeka kangakanani nokuthi kungaba kubi kangakanani. ⚠️ Ubungozi kukugcina ohlwini olulodwa, amaphuzu aphezulu kuqala, ngakunye kunosuku lokuphinde ukubheke.
gloss.chgwin.text: Izikhathi lapho izinguquko zingaphila khona, njengobusuku bangoLwesibili obuthule. Ngaphandle kwewindi ikhadi loshintsho alikwazi ukuqedwa, ngaphandle uma kuyisimo esiphuthumayo.
gloss.gonogo.text: Ukuhlola kokugcina ngaphambi nje kokuba ushintsho luphile: umuntu ngamunye okumele avume uthi Go noma No go. Luqhubeka kuphela uma wonke umuntu ethi Go.
gloss.approval.text: Ukulinda u-yebo ngaphambi kokuthi umsebenzi uqale. Ikhadi eliphakanyiswe ngumngane, noma ushintsho, kulinda ku-✅ Ukuvunywa uze ukuvume noma ukwenqabe.
gloss.quiettime.text: Isikhathi, njengesikhathi sokusakaza bukhoma, idemo noma ubusuku, lapho kungaphili lutho. Amaqembu aqhubeka nokusebenza nokuhlola, kodwa ukuphila kulinda kuze kuphele. Kwenye indawo kubizwa ngokuthi change freeze.
gloss.service.text: Okuthile okwakhile abantu abathembele kukho, njengewebhusayithi noma i-app, okunakekelwayo ukuze kuqhubeke kusebenza. Khetha ukuthi “Le phrojekthi iyisevisi” bese usho ukuthi inikezani, ubani oyisebenzisayo nokuthi ubani olindile.
gloss.uptime.text: Ukuhlola okuzenzakalelayo, njalo ngemizuzu embalwa, ukuthi isevisi yakho isaphendula yini. Uma kwehluleka izikhathi eziningana kulandelana, i-AI-gile ivula ikhadi lesigameko ngokwayo.
gloss.statuspage.text: Ikhasi lomphakathi elikhombisa ukuthi isevisi iyasebenza yini (eluhlaza, ewolintshi noma ebomvu) kanye nesibuyekezo sakamuva, ukuze abantu abayisebenzisayo bazibonele esikhundleni sokubuza.
gloss.incident.text: Okuthile okuphukile noma okungasebenzi kahle kubantu abakusebenzisayo manje, njengewebhusayithi engasebenzi noma ehamba kancane kakhulu. Ikhadi lesigameko elinophawu lwe-🔥 liweqa ulayini: ukuyenza isebenze futhi kuza kuqala.
gloss.major.text: Isigameko esikhulu: abantu abaningi bathintekile, noma imali noma idatha isengozini. Inkinobho eyodwa ibeka wonke amathimba kuso (ukuhlangana), ivuse noma ubani olindile bese icela isibuyekezo sesimo njalo ngemizuzu engu-30.
gloss.oncall.text: Ukuba ngulowo ophendulayo uma kukhona okuphukayo, ngisho nasebusuku. Isevisi ngayinye inelungu lethimba elilindile elivuswa kuqala ezigamekweni zayo.
gloss.replyby.text: Ukuthi ikhadi lingalinda isikhathi esingakanani impendulo yokuqala, isibonelo ihora elilodwa esigamekweni. Ngemva kwalokho lithola iwashi elibomvu, ukuze kungabikho okukhohlwakala buthule. Kubizwa nangokuthi i-response target.
gloss.postmortem.text: Ukubheka emuva okufushane ngemva kwesigameko: kwenzekeni, yini esizile nokuthi yini okufanele ishintshwe, ngaphandle kokusola muntu. Isigameko asikwazi ukuvalwa ngaphandle kwakho. Kubizwa nangokuthi i-post-mortem.
gloss.problem.text: Imbangela efihlekile ngemuva kwesigameko esisodwa noma ngaphezulu. Ikhadi lenkinga 🧩 liqoqa izigameko eziqhubeka zibuya, ukuze imbangela itholakale ilungiswe unomphela.
gloss.rootcause.text: Isizathu sangempela sokuthi kungani okuthile kuphukile, hhayi nje lokho okubone kungahambi kahle. Lungisa imbangela eyinhloko bese isigameko siyeka ukubuya.
gloss.workaround.text: Indlela yokugcina izinto zisebenza kuze kube yilapho ukulungisa kwangempela sekulungile, njengokuqala kabusha okuthile uma kubambeka. Ibhalwa ekhadini lenkinga ukuze kungabikho okufanele akuthole futhi.
gloss.knownerror.text: Inkinga eyaziwa imbangela yayo kodwa engakalungiswa, imvamisa ibhalwe nendlela yesikhashana. I-🧩 Known errors iyazibala, ukuze wonke umuntu asebenzise indlela yesikhashana esikhundleni sokumba futhi.
gloss.runbook.text: Imiyalelo yesinyathelo ngesinyathelo yokulungisa uhlobo lwenkinga olwaziwayo, ukuze kwenziwe ngendlela efanayo, ngokushesha, njalo. Ngemva kwesigameko esikhulu ithimba lingaphakamisa i-runbook ukuze uyivume.
gloss.backup.text: Ikhophi elondoloziwe yedatha yakho yangaphambilini, ongabuyela kuyo uma okuthile kulahlekile noma konakele. I-AI-gile yenza isipele samabhodi akho nsuku zonke.
gloss.restore.text: Ukubuyisa idatha isuka esipeleni. Isipele sibaluleke ngempela kuphela uma wazi ukuthi singabuyiselwa, ngakho kufanele ukuzama ngezikhathi ezithile.
gloss.dod.text: Uhlu olufushane lwethimba lokuthi “kuqediwe” kusho ukuthini, njengokuthi kuhloliwe futhi kuchaziwe, ngaphambi kokuthi ikhadi linikezwe wena. Iwele layo, Incazelo yokulungela, isho ukuthi ikhadi licace ngokwanele nini ukuze liqalwe.
gloss.testpile.text: Amakhadi aqediwe alinde ukuthi uwazame, elinye emva kwelinye. Yamukela elilodwa noma ulibuyisele nenothi, bese kuvela elilandelayo.
gloss.retro.text: Ukubuka emuva njalo ngokuthi iqembu lisebenza kanjani, ukuvumelana ngento eyodwa noma ezimbili ezizokwenziwa kangcono ngokuzayo. Isifinyezo se-retrospective. Ku-AI-gile i-retro iphakamisa ushintsho ezindleleni zeqembu zokusebenza, bese wena uthi Hamba noma Hhayi okwamanje.
gloss.peerreview.text: Amehlo esibili: umuntu ongesiye owabhala uhlola umsebenzi ngaphambi kokuba ufike kuwe, ukuze kudlule amaphutha ambalwa. Ku-AI-gile enye i-AI ihlola ikhadi ngalinye.
gloss.swarm.text: Bonke basize: abantu abaningi bayeka eminye imisebenzi ukuze balungise ndawonye into eyodwa ephuthumayo kuze kuxazululeke. Ku-AI-gile wonke amaqembu asiza kuphrojekthi eyodwa, kuyilapho amanye amaphrojekthi elinda.
gloss.scrummaster.text: Ku-Scrum, umuntu osiza iqembu lisebenze kahle: asuse okuliphazamisayo, agcine imihlangano iqhubeka futhi aqeqeshe imikhuba emihle, ngaphandle kokuyala muntu. Ku-AI-gile i-Lead Scrum Master ibona amakhadi abambekile, iqhuqhuzela amaqembu futhi ikukhumbuze ukuthi yini elindile, kuwo wonke amaphrojekthi.
gloss.scrummaster.text.noai: Ku-Scrum, umuntu osiza iqembu lisebenze kahle: asuse okuliphazamisayo, agcine imihlangano iqhubeka futhi aqeqeshe imikhuba emihle, ngaphandle kokuyala muntu. Ngaphandle kwe-AI, inguqulo ye-AI-gile ibona amakhadi abambekile futhi isebenza ngemiyalo emisiwe, njengokuhlunga u-Okufanele kwenziwe.
gloss.discovery.text: Isigaba sokuqala sokuthola ukuthi iyiphi inkinga efanele ukuxazululwa nokuthi ixazululelwa bani, ngaphambi kokuba kwakhiwe lutho.
gloss.problemstmt.text: Imisho eyodwa noma emibili ethi ngubani onenkinga, iyini nokuthi kungani ibalulekile, ukuze wonke umuntu abheke endaweni eyodwa.
gloss.user.text: Umuntu osebenzisa lokho okwakhayo. Umsebenzi wenzelwa izidingo zakhe.
gloss.stakeholder.text: Noma ubani onendaba nokuthi umsebenzi uphumela kanjani noma othintwa yiwo, njengabantu abakhokhelayo, abawusebenzisayo noma abawusekelayo.
gloss.persona.text: Umuntu owakhiwe kodwa onokwenzeka, omele uhlobo olulodwa lomsebenzisi, ukuze iqembu likwazi ukubuza ukuthi “uSam angakuthola kulula yini lokhu?”
gloss.userresearch.text: Ukukhuluma nabantu bangempela nokubabuka ukuze ufunde ukuthi badingani, kunokuthi uqagele.
gloss.journey.also: izinkambo zabasebenzisi,uhambo lweklayenti,user journey,user journeys,customer journey
gloss.journey.text: Izinyathelo umuntu azithathayo ukuze enze okuthile, kusukela ekuzweni ngakho okokuqala kuze kube yilapho eqeda, naphandle komkhiqizo wakho. Ukukudweba kukhombisa lapho ebambeka khona.
gloss.painpoint.text: Okuthile okucasula noma okubambezela abantu namuhla. Imikhiqizo emihle isusa izindawo ezibuhlungu.
gloss.assumption.text: Okuthile okukholelwayo kodwa ongakakuhloli. Ukubhala phansi okucatshangwayo kukhombisa ukuthi yini okufanele uhlole kuqala.
gloss.hypothesis.text: Isiqagelo sakho esihle ohlela ukusihlola, kanye nalokho okulindele ukwenzeka, njengokuthi “abantu bazobhalisa uma inyanga yokuqala ingenamali”.
gloss.experiment.text: Isivivinyo esincane esihlelwe ukufunda ukuthi umbono uyasebenza yini, ngaphambi kokuthi uzibophezele kakhulu kuwo.
gloss.poc.text: Umzamo osheshayo nongaqediwe wokubona ukuthi umbono ungasebenza yini nhlobo. Kuvame ukulahlwa uma usunempendulo.
gloss.prototype.text: Imodeli yokuqala yomkhiqizo, imvamisa izithombe ezichofozekayo, ukuze uzame umbono kubantu ngaphambi kokuwakha kahle.
gloss.wireframe.text: Umdwebo olula wesikrini okhombisa lapho izinto zihlala khona, ngaphandle kwemibala noma okuqukethwe kwangempela.
gloss.mockup.text: Isithombe esiphelele sokuthi isikrini sizobukeka kanjani, ngemibala nombhalo wangempela, kodwa akukho okusebenzayo okwamanje.
gloss.bizcase.text: Izizathu zokwenza iphrojekthi: ibiza malini, ilethani noma yonga malini, nobungozi bayo.
gloss.feasibility.text: Ukuthi into ingakhiwa futhi ilondolozwe ngempela yini ngesikhathi, imali namakhono onawo.
gloss.outcome.text: Ushintsho olulindele kubantu, njengokuphuthelwa yimihlangano embalwa. Lubaluleke kakhulu kunokuthi wakhe kangakanani.
gloss.output.text: Okuthile okwenziwa yiqembu, njengesikrini esisha noma umbiko. Ukukwenza akusho ukuthi kusiza muntu.
gloss.successmetric.text: Inombolo ekutshela ukuthi umsebenzi wenze yini lokho obuwenzelwe, njengabantu abaningi abaqeda ama-oda abo.
gloss.kpi.text: Inombolo ebalulekile oyibukayo ukuze ubone ukuthi izinto ziyahamba kahle yini, njengokubhalisa ngesonto.
gloss.okr.text: Indlela yokubeka imigomo: inhloso ithi ufunani, futhi imiphumela embalwa eyinhloko yizinombolo ezikhombisa ukuthi ufikile.
gloss.product.text: Into eyakhiwayo futhi ilondolozelwa abasebenzisi bayo, njenge-app, iwebhusayithi noma ithuluzi.
gloss.vision.text: Isitatimende esifushane sokuthi umkhiqizo usiza bani nokuthi uya kuphi esikhathini eside.
gloss.po.text: Umuntu onquma ukuthi yini ezokhiwa nokuthi ngokulandelana okunjani, ukuze iqembu lihlale lisebenza kokubaluleke kakhulu. Ku-AI-gile ngowena lowo.
gloss.pm.text: Umuntu obheka isiqondiso somkhiqizo: yiziphi izinkinga oluxazululayo, kubani nokuthi kungani. I-PM ingasho nomphathi wephrojekthi, ngakho hlola ukuthi yikuphi.
gloss.projmgr.text: Umuntu ogcina iphrojekthi isesikhathini nasesabelomali, elandelela ukuthi ngubani owenzani nini.
gloss.roadmap.text: Uhlelo olubanzi lwalokho okuzayo ezinyangeni ezilandelayo, ngokulandelana. Lukhombisa isiqondiso, hhayi izinsuku eziqondile, futhi luyashintsha njengoba ufunda.
gloss.milestone.text: Iphuzu eliphawulekayo ephrojekthini, njengokuthi “inguqulo yokuqala isiyaphila” noma “abasebenzisi abayi-100”.
gloss.mvp.text: Inguqulo encane kakhulu yomkhiqizo esewusizo ngempela kubantu, ukuze ufunde kubo kusenesikhathi.
gloss.requirement.text: Okuthile umkhiqizo oqediwe okufanele ukwenze noma ube yikho.
gloss.scope.also: ngaphakathi kobubanzi,ngaphandle kobubanzi,in scope,out of scope
gloss.scope.text: Okufakiwe emsebenzini futhi, okubalulekile ngokulinganayo, okungafakiwe.
gloss.scopecreep.text: Uma kwengezwa okuningi nokuningi emsebenzini kancane kancane, kungekho muntu ovumelene ngesikhathi noma izindleko ezengeziwe, ngakho umsebenzi awupheli ngempela.
gloss.feature.text: Into eyodwa umkhiqizo ongayenzela abantu, njengokuthi “setha kabusha iphasiwedi yakho”.
gloss.epic.text: Umsebenzi omkhulu kakhulu ongenziwa ngesikhathi esisodwa, ngakho uhlukaniswa ube amakhadi amancane.
gloss.story.text: Umsebenzi omncane obhalwe ngohlangothi lomsebenzisi: “Njengomthengi, ngifuna ukugcina ubhasikidi wami, ukuze ngiqede kamuva.” Uqala ingxoxo ngokuthi yini okufanele yakhiwe.
gloss.ac.text: Ukuhlola okufanele ikhadi elilodwa lidlule ukuze lithathwe njengelaqediwe, okuvunyelwene ngakho ngaphambi kokuba umsebenzi uqale, njengokuthi “ubhasikidi usekhona ngemva kokuphuma ngingene futhi”.
gloss.task.text: Umsebenzi oyedwa okufanele wenziwe, imvamisa isinyathelo esisodwa esincane sendaba enkulu.
gloss.ticket.text: Elinye igama lekhadi: ucezu olulodwa lomsebenzi noma isicelo esisodwa, esilandelelwa kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni.
gloss.priority.text: Ukuthi into ibaluleke noma iphuthuma kangakanani uma iqhathaniswa nakho konke okunye, ukuze umsebenzi obaluleke kakhulu wenziwe kuqala.
gloss.prioritise.text: Ukubeka umsebenzi ngokulandelana kokubaluleka. Indlela evamile yi-MoSCoW: Kumele kube nakho, Kufanele kube nakho, Kungaba nakho, Ngeke kube nakho kulokhu.
gloss.estimate.text: Ukuqagela okuhle kakhulu ukuthi umsebenzi mkhulu kangakanani noma uzothatha isikhathi esingakanani. Kungukuqagela, hhayi isethembiso.
gloss.storypoints.text: Indlela yokuqagela usayizi womsebenzi ngokuqhathanisa amakhadi (“cishe kukhulu kabili kunalelo”) kunokuba kube ngamahora. Akwenzelwe ukuqhathanisa amaqembu.
gloss.tshirt.text: Ukuqagela usayizi womsebenzi ngo-S, M, L noma XL. Kuyashesha futhi kwanele ekuhleleni kwasekuqaleni.
gloss.poker.text: Umdlalo wokulinganisa: wonke umuntu ubonisa ikhadi losayizi ngesikhathi esisodwa, bese labo abanenombolo ephezulu nephansi kakhulu bachaza ukuthi kungani.
gloss.dependency.text: Uma ucezu olulodwa lomsebenzi lungakwazi ukuqala noma ukuphela kuze kube olunye seluqalile noma seluphelile.
gloss.blocker.text: Noma yini evimbela umsebenzi ukuthi uqhubekele phambili ngalesi sikhathi, njengempendulo engekho noma ithuluzi eliphukile.
gloss.deliverable.text: Okuthile okubambekayo okukhiqizwa umsebenzi bese kudluliselwa kwabanye, njengekhasi elisebenzayo noma umbiko.
gloss.forecast.text: Ukubikezela okungenzeka kwenzeke, njengokuthi umsebenzi uzophela nini, ngokusekelwe kulokho osukwazi kuze kube manje.
gloss.metric.text: Noma yini oyilinganisayo futhi uyilandelele ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, njengenani lezivakashi zekhasi noma isikhathi esithathwa ukulungisa iphutha.
gloss.feedback.text: Lokho abantu bakutshela ngomsebenzi wakho, okuhle nokubi. Ukukuthola kusenesikhathi nangokuvamile kuyinhliziyo ye-Agile.
gloss.agile.also: Agile development,agile ways of working,ukuthuthuka kwe-Agile
gloss.agile.text: Indlela yokusebenza ngezinyathelo ezincane: wakhe kancane, ubonise imiphumela yangempela kaningi, ufunde kulokho abantu abakushoyo bese ushintsha uhlelo ngenkathi uhamba, esikhundleni sokuhlela konke kusengaphambili.
gloss.manifesto.also: Agile Manifesto,Manifesto for Agile Software Development
gloss.manifesto.text: Isitatimende esifushane esabhalwa ngo-2001 ngabenzi besofthiwe. Sibeka abantu, imiphumela esebenzayo, ukusebenza eduze namaklayenti nokuphendula ushintsho ngaphambi kwezinhlelo ezinzima nemibhalo eminingi.
gloss.waterfall.text: Indlela endala yokusebenza: hlela konke, bese wakha konke, bese uhlola konke, isigaba ngesigaba. Izinguquko sekwedlule isikhathi zinzima futhi ziyabiza.
gloss.iteration.text: Umjikelezo owodwa wokwakha okuthile, wokukuhlola nokukuthuthukisa. Umsebenzi we-Agile uyiketango lalokhu, futhi i-sprint luhlobo olulodwa lwawo.
gloss.increment.text: Ucezu olusha olusebenzayo olungezwe emkhiqizweni ku-sprint noma emjikelezweni womsebenzi, olufanelana nalokho obekukhona kakade.
gloss.scrum.text: Indlela edumile ye-Agile yokusebenza: iqembu elincane lisebenza ngama-sprint amafushane lisondela emgomweni, linezindima ezisethiwe nemihlangano embalwa evamile yokuhlela, ukuhlola nokuthuthukisa.
gloss.scrumteam.text: Iqembu elincane elenza umsebenzi ku-Scrum: umnikazi womkhiqizo, i-Scrum Master nabathuthukisi.
gloss.ceremonies.text: Imihlangano evamile ku-Scrum: ukuhlela i-sprint, i-scrum yansuku zonke, ukubuyekeza i-sprint ne-retro. Abantu abaningi bayibiza ngokuthi ama-ceremony (imikhosi).
gloss.sprintplan.text: Umhlangano ekuqaleni kwe-sprint lapho iqembu livumelana ngokuthi kungani i-sprint ibalulekile, ukuthi yimaphi amakhadi elizowathatha nokuthi lizoqala kanjani.
gloss.sprintgoal.text: Umusho owodwa othi i-sprint yenzelwani. Imisebenzi emincane ingashintsha endleleni, inqobo nje uma umgomo ufinyelelwa.
gloss.sprintbacklog.text: Amakhadi akhethelwe i-sprint yamanje, nohlelo leqembu lokuwenza.
gloss.productbacklog.text: Uhlu oluphelele nolulandelanisiwe lwakho konke okungakhiwa komkhiqizo, okubaluleke kakhulu phezulu. Luhlala lushintsha njengoba ufunda.
gloss.productgoal.text: Umphumela omkhulu umkhiqizo osebenzela wona, osiza iqembu likhethe okuzolandela.
gloss.refinement.text: Ukudlula ku-backlog njalo ukuze kuhlelwe, kuhlukaniswe, kulandelaniswe futhi kufakwe imininingwane emakhadini, ukuze alungele ukuthathwa. Kubizwa nangokuthi backlog grooming.
gloss.sprintreview.text: Umhlangano ekupheleni kwe-sprint lapho iqembu libonisa lokho eliqedile futhi lizwe ukuthi abantu bacabangani, ukuze kunqunywe ukuthi kulandela ini.
gloss.demo.text: Ukubonisa umsebenzi oqediwe usebenza, bukhoma, kubantu abawucele.
gloss.timebox.text: Isikhathi esimisiwe sento. Uma siphela uyayeka, noma kungenzekanga konke.
gloss.velocity.text: Ukuthi umsebenzi omningi kangakanani iqembu elivame ukuwuqeda ku-sprint, osetshenziselwa ukuhlela ukuthi kuthathwe kangakanani ngokuzayo. Akuwona amaphuzu okukala ukuthi abantu basebenza kanzima kangakanani.
gloss.capacity.text: Ukuthi umsebenzi omningi kangakanani iqembu elingawuthatha esikhathini, ngemva kwezinsuku zokuphumula neminye imisebenzi.
gloss.burndown.text: Ishadi lomsebenzi osele ku-sprint, lehla usuku nosuku. Uma umugqa ungehli, kukhona okubambekile.
gloss.burnup.text: Ishadi lomsebenzi oqediwe, likhuphuka ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, eduze kwesamba esihlelwe, ukuze ubone ukuthi uzofika nini.
gloss.kanbanboard.text: Ibhodi ngokwalo: isingqimba esisodwa ngesigaba ngasinye somsebenzi, namakhadi ahamba esuka kwesinye aye kwesinye.
gloss.pullsys.text: Indlela yokusebenza lapho umsebenzi omusha uqala kuphela uma othile enendawo yokuwuthatha, esikhundleni sokuthi uphoqelelwe kothile osevele ematasa kakhulu.
gloss.flow.text: Ukuthi umsebenzi uhamba kahle kangakanani ebhodini. Ukugeleza okuhle kusho ukuthi amakhadi ayaqhubeka esikhundleni sokuqongelela.
gloss.leadtime.text: Isikhathi esithathwa kusukela uma othile ecela into kuze kube yilapho iqedwa.
gloss.cycletime.text: Isikhathi ikhadi elisithatha kusukela uma umsebenzi uqala ngempela kulo kuze kube yilapho liqedwa.
gloss.throughput.text: Ukuthi mangaki amakhadi aqedwa ngesonto, noma kunoma yisiphi isikhathi esimisiwe.
gloss.bottleneck.text: Isigaba esisodwa lapho umsebenzi uqongelela futhi ubambezele konke okungemuva, njengentamo emincane yebhodlela.
gloss.swimlane.text: Umugqa onqamula ibhodi ohlanganisa amakhadi ohlobo olulodwa, njengomsebenzi ophuthumayo noma amakhadi eqembu elilodwa.
gloss.lean.text: Indlela yokusebenza esusa ukumosha (noma yini engalisizi iklayenti) futhi igcine umsebenzi ugeleza.
gloss.waste.text: Ku-Lean, noma yini ethatha umzamo kodwa engalisizi iklayenti, njengokulinda, ukwenza kabusha noma ukwakha izinto ezingasetshenziswa muntu.
gloss.kaizen.text: Ukuba ngcono kancane ngaso sonke isikhathi ngezinguquko ezincane ezivamile, bese uhlola ukuthi zisizile yini. Ama-retro ayindlela eyodwa yokukwenza. Kubizwa nangokuthi kaizen.
gloss.selforg.text: Iqembu elizinqumela lona ukuthi lizokwenza kanjani umsebenzi, esikhundleni sokutshelwa isinyathelo ngesinyathelo.
gloss.crossfunc.text: Iqembu elinawo wonke amakhono eliwadingayo ukuze liqede umsebenzi lona, njengokuklama, ukwakha nokuhlola.
gloss.spike.text: Ucwaningo olufushane, olunesikhathi esimisiwe, lokuphendula umbuzo ngaphambi kokuzibophezela emsebenzini wangempela.
gloss.rework.text: Ukwenza umsebenzi futhi ngoba awuzange ulunge okokuqala.
gloss.safe.text: Izindlela zokusebenzisa i-Agile emaqenjini amaningi enhlanganweni enkulu. I-SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework) isibonelo esisodwa esaziwa kakhulu.
gloss.code.text: Iziqondiso ezibhaliwe ezitshela ikhompyutha ukuthi yenzeni. Ibizwa nangokuthi source code.
gloss.proglang.text: Ulimi lokubhala ikhodi, njenge-JavaScript, Python noma Java. Ezehlukene zifanele imisebenzi eyehlukene.
gloss.developer.text: Umuntu obhala futhi ashintshe ikhodi. Ubizwa nangokuthi umhleli wezinhlelo noma unjiniyela wesofthiwe.
gloss.software.text: Izinhlelo ezisebenza kumakhompyutha nasezingcingweni, ngokungafani nemishini ngokwayo (i-hardware).
gloss.app.text: Isifinyezo se-application: uhlelo abantu abalusebenzisayo ukuze benze okuthile, ocingweni, kukhompyutha noma kusiphequluli sewebhu.
gloss.webapp.text: I-app esebenza kusiphequluli sewebhu, ngakho akukho okudingeka kufakwe.
gloss.frontend.text: Ingxenye ye-app oyibonayo futhi oyiqhafazayo: izikrini, izinkinobho namagama, imvamisa kusiphequluli sakho.
gloss.backend.text: Ingxenye ye-app engemuva egcina idatha futhi yenza umsebenzi uma uqhafaza okuthile, njengokuhlola iphasiwedi yakho.
gloss.fullstack.text: Ukusebenza kuyo yomibili i-front end ne-back end.
gloss.ui.text: Lokho umuntu akubonayo futhi akusebenzisayo esikrinini: ukwakheka, izinkinobho, amamenyu namagama.
gloss.ux.text: Ukuthi kuzwakala kanjani ukusebenzisa okuthile: kulula, kuyacaca futhi kuyajabulisa, noma kuyadida futhi kuyahamba kancane.
gloss.accessibility.text: Ukwenza izinto zisetshenziswe yiwo wonke umuntu, kuhlanganise nabantu abangaboni kahle, abangakwazi ukusebenzisa imawusi noma abasebenzisa isifundi sesikrini.
gloss.responsive.text: Ukwenza amakhasi alingane futhi asebenze kahle kunoma yiluphi usayizi wesikrini, kusukela ocingweni kuya kumonitha enkulu.
gloss.designsys.text: Isethi yemibala, amafonti, izinkinobho nemithetho eyabiwe, ukuze zonke izikrini zibukeke futhi zisebenze ngendlela efanayo.
gloss.architecture.text: Isimo sonke sesistimu: yiziphi izingxenye eziyinhloko nokuthi zixhumana kanjani.
gloss.database.text: Indawo ehlelekile yokugcina ulwazi, njenge-spreadsheet enamandla kakhulu i-app engayifunda futhi iyishintshe.
gloss.schema.text: Ukuhlelwa kwesizindalwazi: yimaphi amathebula olwazi esinawo nokuthi kungena ini kulelo nalelo.
gloss.sql.text: Isifinyezo se-structured query language: ulimi olusetshenziselwa ukucela ulwazi kumasizindalwazi amaningi noma ukulushintsha.
gloss.data.text: Ulwazi olugcinwe yikhompyutha, njengamagama, ama-oda noma izilungiselelo.
gloss.server.text: Ikhompyutha ehlala ivuliwe futhi iphendula izicelo zamanye amakhompyutha, njengokuthumela ikhasi lewebhu uma ulivakashele.
gloss.client.text: Uhlangothi olucela okuthile, imvamisa isiphequluli noma i-app yakho, ekhuluma neseva. Ebhizinisini kusho nje umthengi.
gloss.api.text: Isifinyezo se-application programming interface: imenyu esethiwe yezicelo okungenziwa uhlelo olulodwa kolunye, njengokucela isibikezelo sanamuhla enkonzweni yesimo sezulu.
gloss.endpoint.text: Into eyodwa kumenyu ye-API: ikheli lewebhu uhlelo olungalibiza ukuze lithole noma lithumele okuthile.
gloss.integration.text: Ukuxhumanisa izinhlelo ezimbili ukuze zisebenzisane, njengesitolo sakho sithumela ama-oda kusofthiwe yakho yama-akhawunti.
gloss.webhook.text: Umlayezo uhlelo olulodwa oluthumela kolunye ngokwalo ngokushesha nje lapho kwenzeka okuthile, njengokuthi “inkokhelo isitholakele”.
gloss.library.text: Ikhodi eselungile ebhalwe ngomunye umuntu ongayisebenzisa kabusha esikhundleni sokuzibhalela yona.
gloss.framework.text: Isakhiwo esiselungile sokwakha i-app esinquma okuningi ngokuthi ikhodi ihlelwe kanjani, njengohlaka lwendlu obese uyalugcwalisa.
gloss.sdk.text: Ibhokisi lamathuluzi, ikhodi nezibonelo zokwakha isofthiwe yeplatifomu eyodwa noma isevisi eyodwa.
gloss.softdep.text: Umtapo noma ithuluzi ikhodi yakho elidingayo ukuze isebenze. Ukuzibuyekeza njalo kubalulekile ekuphepheni.
gloss.package.text: Inqwaba yekhodi eselungile ongayifaka futhi uyisebenzise ephrojekthini.
gloss.pkgmgr.text: Ithuluzi elilanda futhi libuyekeze amaphakheji ikhodi yakho encike kuwo. I-npm ingenye evamile.
gloss.git.text: Ithuluzi elisetshenziswa kakhulu lokugcina umlando wezinguquko zekhodi, njengama-commit namagatsha.
gloss.github.text: Iwebhusayithi egcina ama-repo e-Git ku-inthanethi, ukuze amaqembu abelane ngekhodi, abuyekeze izinguquko futhi alandelele umsebenzi.
gloss.vcs.text: Ukugcina umlando ophelele wazo zonke izinguquko kumafayela, ukuze ubone ukuthi ngubani oshintshe ini futhi ubuyele emuva uma kudingeka. I-Git iyakwenza lokhu.
gloss.clone.text: Ukwenza ikhophi yakho ephelele ye-repo, nomlando wayo, kukhompyutha yakho.
gloss.pull.text: Ukulanda ama-commit akamuva avela ekhophi ebelwanayo (njenge-GitHub) kukhompyutha yakho. Okuphambene ne-push.
gloss.mainbranch.text: Inguqulo esemthethweni yekhodi wonke umuntu asebenza kuyo, ebizwa kaningi ngokuthi main noma master.
gloss.conflict.text: Uma izinguquko ezimbili zithinta imigqa efanayo ngezindlela ezihlukile, ngakho ikhompyutha ayikwazi ukuzihlanganisa futhi umuntu kumele akhethe.
gloss.diff.text: Ukubuka okukhombisa ngqo ukuthi yini eshintshile phakathi kwezinguqulo ezimbili: imigqa engeziwe nemigqa esusiwe.
gloss.fork.text: Ikhophi yakho ye-repo yomunye umuntu, ongayishintsha ngaphandle kokuthinta eyakhe.
gloss.script.text: Uhlelo olufushane olwenza umsebenzi owodwa ngokwalo, njengokuhlela amafayela noma ukuqala i-app.
gloss.build.text: Ukuguqula ikhodi ibe yinto eselungele ukusebenza, noma umphumela ongokwawo osulungele ukusebenza.
gloss.compile.text: Ukuhumusha ikhodi ebhalwe abantu ibe yifomu ikhompyutha engayisebenzisa ngqo.
gloss.cli.text: Iwindi lombhalo lapho uthayipha iziqondiso zekhompyutha esikhundleni sokuqhafaza. Libizwa nangokuthi i-terminal.
gloss.config.text: Izilungiselelo ezilawula indlela isofthiwe esebenza ngayo, ezigcinwe ngokwehlukile kukhodi ukuze kube lula ukuzishintsha.
gloss.envvar.text: Isilungiselelo esinikezwa uhlelo uma luqala, esivame ukusetshenziselwa amakheli noma amaphasiwedi ukuze angabhalwa ekhodini.
gloss.debugging.text: Ukuzingela ukuthi kungani into ingasebenzi, bese uyilungisa.
gloss.pairing.text: Abantu ababili (noma umuntu ne-AI) basebenza ndawonye ekhodini efanayo, omunye uthayipha omunye uhlola.
gloss.docs.text: Izincazelo ezibhaliwe zokuthi into isebenza kanjani noma ukuthi isetshenziswa kanjani.
gloss.readme.text: Ifayela lokuqala okufanele ulifunde ku-repo: ukuthi iphrojekthi iyini nokuthi uyiqalisa kanjani.
gloss.legacy.text: Uhlelo oludala olusasetshenziswa olunzima ukuluguqula, imvamisa ngoba bambalwa abantu abasaluqondayo.
gloss.techdebt.text: Izindlela ezimfushane ezonga isikhathi manje kodwa zenze izinguquko zakamuva zihambe kancane, njengesikweletu esikhula nenzalo. I-refactor iyasinciphisa.
gloss.autotest.text: Ukuhlola ikhompyutha ekwenza ngokwayo njalo uma ikhodi ishintsha, ukubamba amaphutha kusenesikhathi.
gloss.manualtest.text: Umuntu ozama umsebenzi ngesandla ukuze abone ukuthi uyenza ngendlela efanele yini.
gloss.unittest.text: Ukuhlola okuzenzakalelayo okuncane kocezu olulodwa oluncane lwekhodi lodwa.
gloss.integtest.text: Ukuhlola ukuthi izingxenye eziningana zisebenza kahle ndawonye, hhayi eyodwa ngesikhathi.
gloss.endtoend.text: Ukuhlola okwenza njengomsebenzisi wangempela kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni, njengokubhalisa, ukuthenga nokukhokha.
gloss.uat.text: Abantu abacele umsebenzi bawuzama bona ngokwabo bese bethi uyakwenza yini abakudingayo. Isitaki sokuhlola se-AI-gile siyinguqulo yalokhu.
gloss.regression.text: Okuthile okwakusebenza kodwa kwaphuka ngemva kokushintsha. Ukuhlola kwe-regression kuhlola ukuthi izinto zakudala zisasebenza yini.
gloss.smoke.text: Ukuhlola okusheshayo kakhulu ukuthi izinto eziyinhloko zisebenza nhlobo yini, isibonelo ngokushesha ngemva kokuba inguquko iphile. Uma kwehluleka, yima bese ubheka.
gloss.exploratory.text: Ukuzama umkhiqizo ngokukhululeka futhi uwuhlolisise ngezindlela ezihlukene, ukuze uthole izinkinga ukuhlola okuhleliwe obekungeke kuzibone.
gloss.testcase.text: Isimo esisodwa esibhaliwe sokuzama: izinyathelo, nalokho okufanele kwenzeke.
gloss.coverage.text: Ukuthi ingakanani ikhodi ehlolwa ukuhlola okuzenzakalelayo. Ngokuvamile okwengeziwe kuphephile kakhulu, kodwa ukumbozwa okuphezulu kuphela akufakazeli ukuthi isebenza kahle.
gloss.testdata.text: Ulwazi lwesibonelo olwenziwe ukuze lusetshenziswe ngenkathi kuhlolwa, ukuze imininingwane yangasese yomuntu wangempela ingadalulwa.
gloss.edgecase.text: Isimo esingajwayelekile emikhawulweni, njengefomu elingenalutho noma igama elinophawu lwe-apostrophe ('), lapho izinto zivame ukuphuka khona.
gloss.happypath.text: Indlela evamile lapho yonke into iya kahle. Ukuhlola okuhle kuzama nezindlela ezingajabulisi.
gloss.perftest.text: Ukuhlola ukuthi into isheshe kangakanani nokuthi ikwazi kanjani ukumelana nengcindezi.
gloss.loadtest.text: Ukuhlola ukuthi isistimu imelana kanjani uma abantu abaningi beyisebenzisa ngesikhathi esisodwa.
gloss.sectest.text: Ukubheka ubuthakathaka obungavumela umuntu ukuthi asebenzise kabi isistimu noma abone lokho okungafanele akubone.
gloss.accesstest.text: Ukuhlola ukuthi abantu abanamakhono ahlukene bangawusebenzisa yini umkhiqizo, kuhlanganise nesifundi sesikrini noma ikhibhodi kuphela.
gloss.linting.text: Ukuhlola okuzenzakalelayo okubona amaphutha angase abe khona nesitayela esingahlelekile ekhodini, njengesihloli sokupela sezinhlelo.
gloss.static.text: Ukuhlola ikhodi ukuthola izinkinga ngokuyifunda ngokuzenzakalelayo, ngaphandle kokuyiqhuba.
gloss.flaky.text: Ukuhlola kwesinye isikhathi okuphumelelayo nesinye isikhathi okwehlulekayo ngaphandle kwesizathu esicacile, ngakho akunakwethenjwa ngokuphelele.
gloss.repro.text: Ukwenza iphutha lenzeke futhi ngamabomu ngokulandela izinyathelo ezifanayo, ukuze lifundwe futhi lilungiswe. Ukubhala phansi lezo zinyathelo yingxenye ewusizo kakhulu embikweni wephutha.
gloss.severity.text: Ukuthi umthelela wenkinga ubi kangakanani, kusukela ekucasukeni okuncane kuya ekumeni kwayo yonke into.
gloss.devops.text: Indlela yokusebenza lapho abantu abakha isofthiwe nalabo abayiphethe basebenza njengeqembu elilodwa, ngokuzenzakalelayo okuningi, ukuze izinguquko ziphile kaningi futhi ngokuphepha.
gloss.cicd.text: Izinguquko zawo wonke umuntu ziyahlanganiswa enguqulweni eyinhloko kaningi futhi ziyahlolwa ngokuzenzakalelayo njalo (ukuhlanganisa okuqhubekayo), ukuze isofthiwe ihlale ilungele ukuphila ngokucindezela inkinobho (ukulethwa okuqhubekayo).
gloss.contdeploy.text: Isinyathelo esisodwa ngaphezu kokulethwa okuqhubekayo: yonke inguquko edlula ekuhlolweni iphila yodwa, akukho nkinobho okumele icindezelwe.
gloss.pipeline.text: Uchungechunge oluzenzakalelayo lwezinyathelo inguquko eludlulayo endleleni eya ekuphileni, njengokwakha, ukuhlola, bese kukhishwa.
gloss.environment.text: Ikhophi eyodwa ehlukile yesistimu enenhloso eyodwa, njengenye yokwakha kuyo, enye yokuhlola kuyo neyaphilayo.
gloss.devenv.text: Ikhophi umthuthukisi asebenza kuyo, imvamisa kukhompyutha yakhe, lapho ukophula izinto kungalimazi muntu.
gloss.testenv.text: Ikhophi ehlukile yesistimu esetshenziselwa ukuhlola kuphela, ukuze isevisi yangempela ingathintwa.
gloss.staging.text: Ikhophi yokugcina esethwe njengeyaphilayo, yokuhlola kokugcina ngaphambi kokuba inguquko iphile.
gloss.artifact.text: Ifayela noma iqoqo i-build elikhiqizayo, elilungele ukugcinwa, ukuhlolwa noma ukuphila.
gloss.hotfix.text: Ukulungisa okuphuthumayo okukhishwa ngokushesha, ngaphandle kohlelo olujwayelekile, ngoba okuthile okubalulekile kuphukile.
gloss.patch.text: Isibuyekezo esincane esilungisa iphutha noma sivala imbobo yokuphepha. Ukufaka ama-patch okuphepha ngokushesha kubalulekile.
gloss.version.text: Ilebuli efana ne-2.4.1 ekutshela ukuthi unayiphi inguqulo. Imvamisa inombolo yokuqala ishintsha ezinguqukweni ezinkulu neyokugcina ekulungisweni okuncane.
gloss.relnotes.text: Uhlu olufushane nolulula lwalokho okushintshile enguqulweni, olwabantu abayisebenzisayo, kuhlanganise nokulungisiwe nemikhawulo eyaziwayo. Kubizwa nangokuthi changelog.
gloss.flag.text: Iswishi yokuvula nokuvala yesici, ukuze umsebenzi omusha uphile ufihlekile bese uvulwa (noma uvalwe futhi) ngaphandle kwenguqulo entsha.
gloss.rollfwd.text: Ukulungisa inguqulo embi ngokukhipha ngokushesha inguqulo entsha elungisiwe esikhundleni sokubuyela kweyakudala.
gloss.canary.text: Ukuphilisa inguquko kuqala eqenjini elincane, bese kubo bonke kuphela uma ibukeka kahle. Igama lithathwe ezinyoni ze-canary abasebenzi basezimayini ababehamba nazo ngaphansi komhlaba njengesixwayiso sokuqala.
gloss.bluegreen.text: Ukugcina amakhophi amabili esistimu ephilayo bese ushintshela abantu kweyodwa entsha ngesikhathi esisodwa, ukuze ukwazi ukubuyela ngqo uma kungahambi kahle.
gloss.zerodown.text: Ukuphilisa inguqulo entsha ngaphandle kokuba isevisi ime nanini kubasebenzisi bayo.
gloss.chgenable.text: Ukusiza izinguquko ziphumelele: ukukala ubungozi, ukuthola imvume efanele nokukhetha isikhathi esihle. Kubizwa nangokuthi change management.
gloss.cab.text: Iqembu elibheka izinguquko ezibalulekile bese livuma ukuthi zingaqhubeka yini nokuthi nini.
gloss.stdchange.text: Ushintsho olunobungozi obuphansi olwenziwa ngendlela efanayo ehloliwe njalo, ngakho luvunywa kusengaphambili.
gloss.normchange.text: Ushintsho oludinga ukuhlolwa nokuvunywa ngaphambi kokuba luqhubeke.
gloss.emergchange.text: Ushintsho okufanele lwenzeke ngokushesha ukulungisa noma ukuvimba inkinga enkulu, ngemvume esheshayo ehambisana nalo.
gloss.automation.text: Ukwenza ikhompyutha yenze umsebenzi ophindaphindwayo ngokwayo, ukuze isheshe futhi yenziwe ngendlela efanayo njalo.
gloss.infra.text: Imishini, amanethiwekhi nezinsiza isofthiwe esebenza kuzo.
gloss.iac.text: Ukuchaza amaseva akho nezilungiselelo kumafayela agcinwe nekhodi, ukuze akwazi ukwakhiwa kabusha ngendlela efanayo njalo.
gloss.cloud.text: Ukuqasha amakhompyutha, isitoreji nezinsiza kumhlinzeki omkhulu nge-inthanethi, esikhundleni sokuba umnikazi wemishini ngokwakho.
gloss.provider.text: Inkampani eqashisa ngamakhompyutha nge-inthanethi, njenge-Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure noma Google Cloud.
gloss.hosting.text: Lapho i-app yakho noma iwebhusayithi yakho ihlala futhi isebenza khona ukuze abantu bayifinyelele, imvamisa iqashwa enkampanini.
gloss.domain.text: Ikheli lewebhu abantu abalithayipha, njenge-example.com. Uliqasha ngonyaka, ngakho kufanele livuselelwe.
gloss.dns.text: Isifinyezo se-domain name system: incwadi yamakheli ye-inthanethi, eguqula igama elinjenge-example.com libe ikheli lekhompyutha efanele.
gloss.container.text: Iphakheji elivaliwe elibamba i-app nakho konke eyikudingayo, ukuze isebenze ngendlela efanayo kunoma iyiphi ikhompyutha. I-Docker ithuluzi eliyaziwa kakhulu.
gloss.vm.text: Ikhompyutha yokuzenzisa esebenza ngaphakathi kweyangempela, ukuze umshini omkhulu owodwa usebenze njengemishini eminingi.
gloss.serverless.text: Ukusebenzisa ikhodi ngaphandle kokunakekela noma yimaphi amaseva ngokwakho: umhlinzeki uyiqhuba uma kudingeka futhi ukhokha kuphela lokho osebenzisile.
gloss.lb.text: Okuthile okusabalalisa izivakashi phakathi kwamaseva amaningana, ukuze kungabikho neyodwa ethwaliswa kakhulu.
gloss.cache.text: Indawo yokugcina eseduze yemiphumela yakamuva, ukuze into efanayo ingadingi ukulandwa noma ukwenziwa futhi. Ukuyisula kungalungisa amakhasi abukeka endala.
gloss.cdn.text: Iqoqo lamaseva emhlabeni wonke eligcina amakhophi amakhasi nezithombe zakho eduze nezivakashi zakho, ukuze zilayishe ngokushesha.
gloss.migration.text: Ukuthuthela idatha noma izinhlelo kusuka ekusetheni okudala kuya kokusha, noma ukushintsha ngokucophelela ukuthi isizindalwazi sihlelwe kanjani.
gloss.svcmgmt.text: Konke okubandakanyekayo ekugcineni isevisi iwusizo futhi isebenza kulabo abayethembele kuyo, usuku nosuku.
gloss.itil.text: Umhlahlandlela osetshenziswa kakhulu wokuphatha amasevisi kahle, ohlanganisa izinto ezinjengezigameko, izinkinga nezinguquko. Igama lalo lalimele i-IT Infrastructure Library.
gloss.itsm.text: Ukuphatha ubuchwepheshe njengesevisi yabantu, ngezindlela ezicacile zokuphatha izicelo, izigameko, izinguquko nokuthuthukisa.
gloss.managed.text: Isevisi omunye umuntu ayiphethe futhi ayinakekela esikhundleni sakho, ngaphansi kwesivumelwano sokuthi kufanele isebenze kahle kangakanani.
gloss.svcowner.text: Umuntu ophendulela isevisi iyonke: ukuthi isebenza kahle kangakanani, ibiza malini nokuthi ithuthuka kanjani.
gloss.sla.text: Isethembiso esibhaliwe samaklayenti sokuthi isevisi izosebenza kahle kangakanani, njengokuthi “iphila ngo-99.9% wesikhathi” noma “iphendulwe ngaphakathi kwehora”, imvamisa nemali ebuyiswayo uma kuphukile.
gloss.slo.text: Okuhlosiwe okungokweqembu mayelana nokuthi isevisi kufanele isebenze kahle kangakanani esikhathini, imvamisa kubekwa kuqine kancane kune-SLA ukuze kuphepheke.
gloss.sli.text: Isilinganiso sangempela osihlola kuqhathaniswa nenhloso, njengengxenye yokuvakasha okulayishe kahle.
gloss.uptimepct.text: Ukuthi ingakanani isikhathi isevisi isebenza ngaso, imvamisa njengephesenti. I-99.9% isavumela cishe imizuzu engama-43 ingasebenzi ngenyanga.
gloss.availability.text: Ukuthi abantu bangayisebenzisa yini isevisi uma beyidinga, okuvame ukulinganiswa nge-uptime.
gloss.downtime.text: Isikhathi lapho isevisi ingasebenzi noma ivaliwe, kuhleliwe noma kungahlelwanga.
gloss.errorbudget.text: Inani elincane lokwehluleka umgomo wakho wokwethembeka olivumelayo. Uma kusasele, ungathatha amathuba ngezinguquko; uma seliphelile, wehlisa ijubane.
gloss.outage.text: Isikhathi lapho isevisi ingasebenzi noma iphuke kakhulu kubasebenzisi bayo.
gloss.degraded.text: Iyasebenza, kodwa kabi: ihamba kancane, noma ezinye izingxenye zayo azisebenzi.
gloss.monitoring.text: Ukubuka isevisi ngokuzenzakalelayo ngaso sonke isikhathi, ukuze izinkinga zibonwe, kungcono ngaphambi kokuba abasebenzisi bazibone.
gloss.observability.text: Ukuthi ukwazi kahle kangakanani ukusho ukuthi kwenzekani ngaphakathi kwesistimu usuka ngaphandle, usebenzisa amalogi ayo, izinombolo namathrekhi.
gloss.log.text: Idayari eqhubekayo uhlelo oluyigcinayo yalokho olwenzayo, esetshenziselwa ukuthola ukuthi yini engahambanga kahle.
gloss.trace.text: Irekhodi lokuthi isicelo esisodwa sihamba kanjani phakathi kwezingxenye ezihlukene zesistimu, isinyathelo ngesinyathelo, kukhombisa lapho sehlise isivinini khona.
gloss.latency.text: Isikhathi esithathwa okuthile ukuphendula, njengokulinda phakathi kokuqhafaza nokuvela kwekhasi.
gloss.alert.text: Umlayezo ozenzakalelayo othi okuthile kudinga ukunakwa, njengewebhusayithi engaphenduli.
gloss.alertfatigue.text: Uma izexwayiso zingaka kangangokuba abantu baqala ukuzishaya indiva, kuhlanganise nezibalulekile.
gloss.dashboard.text: Isikrini esibonisa izinombolo nezimo ezibaluleke kakhulu ngokuphazima kweso.
gloss.paging.text: Ukubiza noma ukuvusa ngokuphuthuma umuntu olindile (on-call) ngenxa yenkinga.
gloss.escalation.text: Ukulethwa komuntu onamakhono amaningi noma igunya elikhulu uma udaba lungaxazululeki ezingeni lamanje, noma lungaxazululeki ngokushesha okwanele.
gloss.triage.text: Ukuhlunga ngokushesha izinkinga ezifikayo ngokuthi zisheshe futhi zibaluleke kangakanani, ukuze ezimbi kakhulu zinakekelwe kuqala.
gloss.impact.text: Ukuthi into ithinta abantu kangakanani: abangaki, nokuthi kubi kangakanani.
gloss.urgency.text: Ukuthi into idinga ukunakwa ngokushesha kangakanani. Umthelela nokuphuthuma ndawonye kunquma okubekwa phambili.
gloss.plevels.text: Amalebuli okuthi udaba luphuthuma kangakanani. I-P1 iyona ebucayi kakhulu futhi idinga isenzo ngokushesha.
gloss.tiers.text: Amazinga osekelo: umugqa wokuqala uthatha ucingo futhi ulungisa izinto ezilula; owesibili unamakhono ajulile ezinto ezinzima. Kubizwa nangokuthi tier 1 ne-tier 2.
gloss.ic.text: Umuntu oyedwa oholela impendulo esigamekweni, ukuze wonke umuntu azi ukuthi ngubani onquma nokuthi ngubani owenzani.
gloss.responsetime.text: Isikhathi esithathwa ngaphambi kokuba othile athathe isicelo noma isigameko okokuqala.
gloss.resolution.also: izikhathi zokuxazulula,resolution time,resolution times,time to resolve
gloss.resolution.text: Isikhathi esithathwa ukuxazulula ngokuphelele isicelo noma isigameko, kusukela ekubikweni kuze kulungiswe.
gloss.mttr.also: MTTR,mean time to restore,Mean time to recover
gloss.mttr.text: Ngokwesilinganiso, isikhathi esithathwa ukuze isevisi isebenze futhi ngemva kokuphuka. I-MTTR ingasho izinto ezihlukile kancane, ngakho sho ukuthi ulinganisani.
gloss.mtbf.text: Ngokwesilinganiso, isikhathi isevisi esebenza ngaso ngaphambi kokuba okuthile kuphuke.
gloss.cmdb.text: Uhlu lwazo zonke izinto zakho zokucushwa nokuthi zixhumana kanjani, ukuze ubone ukuthi yini encike kuphi.
gloss.asset.text: Noma yini ebalulekile oyiphethe noma ukhokhela yona ukuze isevisi isebenze, njengelaptop, ilayisense yesofthiwe noma isizinda.
gloss.capplan.text: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi kuzoba namandla ekhompyutha, isitoreji nabantu abanele lokho okuzayo.
gloss.scaling.text: Ukumelana nabasebenzisi abaningi ngokunika umshini amandla amaningi (scaling up) noma ngokwengeza imishini eminingi (scaling out).
gloss.bcp.text: Izinhlelo zokugcina izinto ezibalulekile ziqhubeka uma okuthile okukhulu kungahambi kahle, njengokulahlekelwa yihhovisi, umhlinzeki obalulekile noma amakhompyutha.
gloss.dr.text: Uhlelo namathuluzi okubuyisa isevisi ngemva kokuthi kwenzeke okubi kakhulu, njengokulahlekelwa yisikhungo sedatha esiphelele.
gloss.rto.text: Isikhathi eside kakhulu isevisi engahlala ingasebenzi ngemva kwenhlekelele ngaphambi kokuba kufanele isebenze futhi.
gloss.rpo.text: Ukuthi ingakanani idatha yakamuva ongakwazi ukulahlekelwa yiyo, ekalwa ngesikhathi. I-RPO yehora elilodwa isho izipele okungenani njalo ngehora.
gloss.redundancy.text: Ukuba nezinto ezilindile ezilungile, njengeseva yesibili, ukuze ukwehluleka okukodwa kungayimisi isevisi.
gloss.failover.text: Ukushintshela ngokuzenzakalelayo kusistimu elindile uma ejwayelekile yehluleka.
gloss.spof.word: Iphuzu elilodwa lokwehluleka (Single point of failure)
gloss.spof.also: single points of failure,SPOF,Single point of failure
gloss.spof.text: Ingxenye eyodwa eyehlisa yonke into uma iphuka, ngoba akukho okulindile.
gloss.maintwin.text: Isikhathi esihleliwe lapho isevisi ingamiswa noma ihambe kancane ukuze inakekelwe, imenyezelwe kubasebenzisi kusengaphambili.
gloss.handover.text: Ukudlulisela umsebenzi, ulwazi nomthwalo kumunye umuntu noma iqembu, ukuze kungalahleki lutho.
gloss.kb.text: Iqoqo lezihloko zosizo nezimpendulo, zabasebenzisi neqembu.
gloss.csat.text: Amaphuzu avela kubasebenzisi abonisa ukuthi bajabule kangakanani, avame ukucelwa ngemva kokuvalwa kwesicelo.
gloss.supplier.text: Inkampani yangaphandle oyethembele kuyo, njengomhlinzeki wakho we-hosting. Ibizwa nangokuthi vendor noma third party.
gloss.retire.text: Ukuvala isevisi unomphela, ngokuphepha: ukwazisa abasebenzisi bayo, ukuphatha idatha nokufinyelela kwayo, nokuqeda izindleko zayo.
gloss.eol.text: Uma umkhiqizo uyeka ukuthola izibuyekezo noma usekelo kumkhiqizi wawo, ngakho kufanele ushintshwe.
gloss.cybersec.text: Ukuvikela izistimu nedatha ekuphulweni, ekutshontshweni noma ekonakalisweni.
gloss.authn.text: Ukuhlola ukuthi umuntu ungubani, imvamisa ngephasiwedi noma ikhodi. Kuvame ukufushaniswa kube i-authn.
gloss.authz.text: Ukuhlola ukuthi umuntu uvunyelwe ukwenzani uma usuyazi ukuthi ungubani. Kuvame ukufushaniswa kube i-authz.
gloss.mfa.text: Ukungena ngobufakazi obubili noma ngaphezulu, njengephasiwedi nekhodi ocingweni lwakho. Kubizwa nangokuthi two-factor (2FA).
gloss.sso.text: Ukungena kanye ukuze ungene ezistimini eziningi, njengokusebenzisa i-akhawunti yakho yomsebenzi yonke indawo.
gloss.pwmgr.text: I-app edala amaphasiwedi aqinile futhi ikukhumbulele wona.
gloss.secret.text: Iphasiwedi, ukhiye noma enye ikhodi yangasese uhlelo olisebenzisayo ukungena kokuthile. Akumele kwabelwane ngayo noma kubhalwe ekhodini.
gloss.apikey.text: Ikhodi yangasese evumela uhlelo ukuthi lisebenzise i-API yenye isevisi, futhi ikhombisa ukuthi ngubani oyisebenzisayo (nokhokhelayo).
gloss.accesstoken.text: Ipasi lesikhashana eliqinisekisa ukuthi uhlelo luvunyelwe ukungena, ukuze lungadingi iphasiwedi yakho njalo. Alifani ne-AI token.
gloss.encryption.text: Ukuxubanisa ulwazi ukuze umuntu onokhiye ofanele kuphela akwazi ukulufunda.
gloss.https.text: Indlela evikelekile amakhasi ewebhu ahamba ngayo, ekhonjiswa yisikhiya kusiphequluli sakho, ukuze kungabikho ophakathi ongawafunda noma awashintshe.
gloss.cert.text: Ikhadi le-ID lamadijithali eliyivumela iwebhusayithi ukuthi ifakazele ukuthi iyini futhi isebenzise i-HTTPS. Liyaphelelwa isikhathi, ngakho kumele livuselelwe.
gloss.permissions.text: Imithetho yokuthi ngubani ongabona noma ashintshe ini.
gloss.leastpriv.text: Ukunika umuntu ngamunye noma uhlelo ngalunye ukufinyelela okudingayo ngempela kuphela, isikhathi esidingayo kuphela.
gloss.rbac.text: Ukunikeza ukufinyelela ngendima, njengobukayo noma ohlelayo, esikhundleni somuntu ngamunye.
gloss.vuln.text: Indawo ebuthakathaka umuntu angayisebenzisa ukuze angene noma alimaze.
gloss.zeroday.text: Ubuthakathaka abahlaseli abazi ngabo ngaphambi kokuba abenzi babe nesikhathi sokubulungisa.
gloss.malware.text: Isofthiwe eyingozi, njengamawayirasi, eyenzelwe ukulimaza, ukuqamekela noma ukutshontsha.
gloss.ransomware.text: I-malware evala amafayela akho futhi icela imali ukuze iwavule. Izipele ezinhle yizona ezikuvikela kangcono.
gloss.phishing.text: Imilayezo yamanga ezama ukukukhohlisa ukuze unikeze amaphasiwedi noma imali, noma uvule okuyingozi.
gloss.socialeng.text: Ukukhohlisa abantu, hhayi amakhompyutha, ukuze banikeze ukufinyelela, njengocingo lwamanga oluvela “ekusekelweni kwe-IT”.
gloss.firewall.text: Umqaphi onquma ukuthi iyiphi ithrafikhi yenethiwekhi evunyelwe ukungena noma ukuphuma.
gloss.vpn.text: Isifinyezo se-virtual private network: isixhumo sangasese esifihliwe nge-inthanethi, esivame ukusetshenziselwa ukufinyelela ezinhlelweni zomsebenzi ngokuphepha.
gloss.ddos.text: Ukukhukhula isevisi ngethrafikhi eningi yamanga kangangokuba abantu bangempela bangakwazi ukuyisebenzisa. I-DDoS isho ukuthi iphuma emakhompyutheni amaningi ngesikhathi esisodwa.
gloss.pentest.text: Ukuqasha ochwepheshe abanobungane ukuthi bazame ukungena, ukuze ubuthakathaka butholwe ngaphambi kokuba abahlaseli bangempela babuthole.
gloss.audit.text: Ukuhlola ngokucophelela ukuthi into ivikelwe kahle kangakanani, kuqhathaniswa nohlu lwemikhuba emihle.
gloss.threatmodel.text: Ukucabanga ngokuthi ngubani ongahlasela into, kanjani, nokuthi ungenzani ukubavimba.
gloss.breach.text: Uma ulwazi lwangasese lufika kubantu okungafanele balube nalo, noma lulahleka noma lushintshwa ngaphandle kwemvume.
gloss.pii.text: Noma yimuphi ulwazi ngomuntu ongahlonzwa, njengegama, ikheli le-imeyili noma indawo. Lubizwa nangokuthi PII.
gloss.gdpr.text: Umthetho waseYurophu wedatha yomuntu siqu (i-UK inenguqulo yayo): qoqa kuphela okudingayo, kugcine kuphephile, futhi wenze abantu bakwazi ukubona noma ukusula eyabo.
gloss.dataprot.text: Ukunakekela idatha yomuntu siqu ngokufanele nangaphakathi komthetho.
gloss.privacypolicy.text: Ikhasi elisesidlangalaleni elithi yiluphi ulwazi lomuntu siqu oluqoqayo, kungani, nokuthi ulwenzani.
gloss.consent.text: Impendulo yebo ecacile nekhululekile yomuntu yokuthi idatha yakhe isetshenziswe ngendlela ethile. Angayibuyisa noma nini.
gloss.cookie.text: Ifayela elincane iwebhusayithi eyigcina kusiphequluli sakho ukuze ikhumbule izinto, njengokuthi ungenile. Amanye adinga imvume yakho kuqala.
gloss.minimisation.text: Ukuqoqa nokugcina kuphela idatha yomuntu siqu oyidinga ngempela emsebenzini.
gloss.retention.text: Ukuthi idatha igcinwa isikhathi esingakanani ngaphambi kokuba isulwe. Ukungayigcini ngaphezu kokudingekile kuphephile kakhulu futhi kuvame ukuba ngumthetho.
gloss.anon.text: Ukushintsha idatha ukuze kungabikho umuntu ongaphinda ahlonzwe ngayo ngendlela enengqondo.
gloss.pseudo.text: Ukushintshanisa amagama neminye imininingwane ngamakhodi, nokhiye ogcinwe ngokwehlukile wokuwaxhumanisa futhi. Kodwa isabalwa njengedatha yomuntu siqu.
gloss.dpa.text: Inkontileka ethi umhlinzeki angayiphatha kanjani idatha yomuntu siqu egameni lakho.
gloss.dpia.text: Ukubheka ngokucophelela, ngaphambi kokuqala, ukuthi uhlelo lokusebenzisa idatha yomuntu siqu lungathinta kanjani abantu nokuthi ungabehlisa kanjani ubungozi.
gloss.auditlog.text: Irekhodi lokuthi ngubani owenzeni nini, ukuze izenzo zihlolwe kamuva.
gloss.compliance.text: Ukulandela imithetho, imithethonqubo namazinga akusebenzelayo, nokukwazi ukukhombisa ukuthi uyakwenza.
gloss.iso.text: Izinga lamazwe ngamazwe elaziwa kakhulu lokuphatha ukuphepha kolwazi. Izinkampani zingaqinisekiswa ngalo.
gloss.soc.text: Umbiko wase-US, ohlolwe ngabahloli bangaphandle, okhombisa ukuthi inkampani inakekela kahle idatha yamakhasimende.
gloss.ai.text: Izistimu zekhompyutha ezenza izinto esivame ukucabanga ukuthi zidinga umuntu, njengokubhala, ukuphendula imibuzo noma ukubona izithombe.
gloss.ml.text: Indlela yokwenza amakhompyutha afunde amaphethini ezibonelweni eziningi, esikhundleni sokuwanika imithetho eqondile.
gloss.model.text: “Ubuchopho” obuqeqeshiwe bohlelo lwe-AI, obakhiwe ngokufunda ezibonelweni eziningi kakhulu. Amamodeli ahlukile ekhonweni, ekushesheni nasentengo.
gloss.llm.text: Imodeli ye-AI eqeqeshwe ngombhalo omningi kakhulu, ukuze ikwazi ukufunda nokubhala ulimi.
gloss.genai.text: I-AI edala izinto ezintsha, njengombhalo, izithombe noma ikhodi, esikhundleni sokuhlunga noma ukubona kuphela.
gloss.chatbot.text: Uhlelo oxoxa nalo ngolimi lwansuku zonke, ngokuthayipha noma ngokukhuluma.
gloss.prompt.text: Lokho okunika i-AI: umbuzo wakho noma iziqondiso, kanye nanoma yini oyinikayo. Ama-prompt acacile ngokuvamile athola izimpendulo ezingcono.
gloss.prompteng.text: Ikhono lokubhala ama-prompt athola imiphumela ethembekile newusizo.
gloss.sysprompt.text: Iziqondiso zangemuva i-AI ezithola ngaphambi kokuba ingxoxo iqale, zibeka indima nemithetho yayo. Zinesisindo esikhulu kunalokho okuthayiphayo.
gloss.context.text: Konke i-AI engakubona ngenkathi isebenza: iziqondiso, imilayezo yakho, amafayela ewafundile nezimpendulo zangaphambilini.
gloss.ctxwin.text: Ukuthi i-AI ingagcina kangakanani engqondweni ngesikhathi esisodwa, okulinganiswa ngama-token. Uma kudlulwa lapho, izingxenye ezindala ziyalahlwa noma zifinyezwe.
gloss.session.text: Ingxoxo eyodwa yomsebenzi ne-AI, kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni. Iseshini entsha iqala ngenkumbulo entsha.
gloss.memory.text: Amanothi i-AI iwagcina phakathi kwamaseshini, ukuze ikhumbule okuthandayo nezinqumo zangaphambilini.
gloss.hallucination.text: Uma i-AI isho okuthile okuzwakala kuqinisekile kodwa kuqanjiwe noma kungalungile. Hlola amaqiniso abalulekile.
gloss.training.text: Ukufundisa imodeli ngokuyikhombisa izibonelo eziningi kakhulu, ngaphambi kokuba muntu ayisebenzise.
gloss.trainingdata.text: Izibonelo imodeli efunde kuzo. Ulwazi lwayo luphela ngosuku leyo datha eyaqoqwa ngalo.
gloss.cutoff.text: Usuku ulwazi olwakhelwe ku-AI oluphela ngalo. Ngeke yazi ngezinto zakamuva ngaphandle kokuthi izifunde ngokusesha.
gloss.finetune.text: Ukuqeqeshwa okwengeziwe kwemodeli ekhona ngezibonelo zakho, ukuze ibe ngcono emsebenzini oyedwa othile.
gloss.inference.text: Imodeli ye-AI ngenkathi isetshenziswa ngempela ukuphendula okuthile, ngokungafani nenkathi iqeqeshwa.
gloss.tooluse.text: I-AI ikwazi ukwenza izinto, hhayi ukukhuluma kuphela: ukusebenzisa imiyalo, ukufunda amafayela noma ukusesha iwebhu, ngamathuluzi i-app iyinika wona.
gloss.subagent.text: I-AI esizayo leyo i-AI eyinhloko eyinika umsebenzi omncane, bese ithola umphumela kuyo.
gloss.multiagent.text: Ama-AI amaningana asebenza ndawonye kucezu lomsebenzi olulodwa, ngalinye linengxenye yalo, njengeqembu elincane.
gloss.autonomy.text: Ukuthi i-AI ingenza kangakanani yodwa ngaphambi kokuthi ibuze umuntu.
gloss.hitl.text: Ukugcina umuntu ebandakanyekile ukuhlola noma ukuvuma lokho i-AI ekwenzayo emaphuzwini abalulekile. Ku-AI-gile yiwena lowo.
gloss.guardrails.text: Imikhawulo nokuhlolwa okugcina izenzo ze-AI ziphephile, njengokudinga imvume ngaphambi kokuba kuphile okuthile. Kunciphisa ubungozi bamaphutha, kodwa akubususi ngokuphelele.
gloss.rag.text: Ukuvumela i-AI ukuthi ibheke izinto emibhalweni yakho ngaphambi kokuphendula, ukuze izimpendulo zayo zisekelwe emaqinisweni akho.
gloss.embedding.text: Ukuguqula umbhalo ube uhlu lwezinombolo olubamba incazelo yawo, ukuze ikhompyutha ithole izinto ezisho into efanayo.
gloss.vectordb.text: Isizindalwazi esakhelwe ukusesha lolo hlu lwezinombolo (ama-embedding), ukuthola izinto ezinencazelo efanayo.
gloss.mcp.text: Indlela evamile yokuxhuma amathuluzi nemithombo yedatha kuma-app e-AI, ukuze i-AI ikwazi ukuwasebenzisa.
gloss.temperature.text: Isilungiselelo sokuthi izimpendulo ze-AI zehlukahluka kangakanani. Ephansi inika izimpendulo ezizinzile nezibikezelekayo; ephezulu inika ezehlukahlukene kakhulu. Akukho neyodwa eyenza ihlale ilungile.
gloss.multimodal.text: Ikwazi ukusebenza ngohlobo olungaphezu koluyedwa lolwazi, njengombhalo, izithombe nomsindo.
gloss.evals.text: Ukuhlola okuhleliwe ukuthi i-AI isebenza kahle kangakanani ezibonelweni ezikhethiwe, ukuze uqhathanise amamodeli noma ama-prompt.
gloss.bias.text: Uma i-AI (noma umuntu) ithambekela ngokungafanele ohlangothini olulodwa, imvamisa ngenxa yalokho ekufunde kukho.
gloss.responsible.text: Ukusebenzisa i-AI ngobulungiswa, ngokuphepha nangokwethembeka, abantu besaphendula ngemiphumela.
gloss.injection.text: Ubuqili lapho iziqondiso ezifihliwe ekhasini lewebhu noma efayelini zizama ukwenza i-AI yenze into umsebenzisi wayo angayicelanga.
gloss.ratelimit.text: Umkhawulo wokuthi mangaki izicelo ongazithumela enkonzweni esikhathini esimisiwe. Uma udlula kuwo, kumele ulinde.
gloss.usagelimit.text: Ukuthi umsebenzi we-AI omningi kangakanani uhlelo lwakho oluwuvumelayo esikhathini, ngemva kwalokho uyama noma ubiza kakhulu.
gloss.vibe.text: Ukwakha isofthiwe ikakhulukazi ngokuchaza ofuna ku-AI bese uyivumela ibhale ikhodi.
gloss.costest.text: Ukuqagela okuhle kakhulu kokuthi into izobiza malini ngaphambi kokuba uqale.
gloss.roi.text: Lokho okubuyelayo uma kuqhathaniswa nalokho okufakile. Uma kunenzuzo, bekufanelekile.
gloss.tco.text: Konke okubizwa yinto ngempela empilweni yayo yonke, hhayi nje intengo yokuyithenga: ukuyisebenzisa, ukuyisekela, ukuyithuthukisa nokugcina ukuyisusa ekusebenzeni.
gloss.capex.text: I-CapEx imali echithwa kusengaphambili ezintweni ozigcinayo; i-OpEx ukuchitha okuqhubekayo, njengamabhili ngenyanga.
gloss.subscription.text: Ukukhokha njalo, imvamisa ngenyanga noma ngonyaka, ukuze uqhubeke usebenzisa okuthile.
gloss.saas.text: Isofthiwe oyisebenzisa nge-inthanethi bese uyikhokhela ngenkokhelo eqhubekayo, kuyilapho umkhiqizi ekuphathela yona.
gloss.payg.text: Ukukhokhela kuphela lokho okusebenzisayo, njengamakhompyutha efu noma ama-token e-AI.
gloss.overage.text: Ukusetshenziswa okungaphezu kwalokho uhlelo lwakho olukuhlanganisayo, okungabiza okwengeziwe.
gloss.billingalert.text: Umlayezo uma ukuchitha noma ukusetshenziswa kufinyelela izinga olikhethile. Uyakuxwayisa, kodwa awuzimisi njalo izindleko ezengeziwe.
gloss.freetier.text: Izinga lamahhala lesevisi ekhokhelwayo, elinemikhawulo. Lilusizo uma uqala.
gloss.pricing.text: Amaphakheji ahlukene isevisi ewathengisayo, ngalinye linentengo yalo nemikhawulo yalo.
gloss.licence.text: Imithetho yokuthi ungasebenzisa kanjani, ukopishe, ushintshe noma wabelane ngento eyenziwe ngomunye umuntu, njengesofthiwe, amafonti noma izithombe.
gloss.opensource.text: Isofthiwe ikhodi yayo wonke umuntu angayifunda, ayisebenzise futhi imvamisa ayishintshe mahhala, ngaphansi kwemithetho yelayisense yayo.
gloss.osslicence.also: open source licence,open source licences,MIT licence,GPL
gloss.osslicence.text: Imithetho ehambisana nekhodi yomthombo ovulekile. Ezinye zikuvumela ukwenza cishe noma yini (njenge-MIT); ezinye zicela ukuthi wabelane ngezinguquko zakho nazo (njenge-GPL).
gloss.proprietary.text: Ingeyenkampani futhi ayikhululekile ukukopishwa noma ukushintshwa. Okuphambene nomthombo ovulekile.
gloss.copyright.text: Ilungelo elisemthethweni lomdali lokulawula amakhophi emisebenzi yakhe, kuhlanganise nekhodi nokubhaliwe.
gloss.ip.text: Imibono nezidalwa umthetho ozibheka njengezinomnikazi, njengekhodi, imiklamo, amagama nama-logo.
gloss.tos.also: terms and conditions,terms of use,terms of service
gloss.contract.text: Isivumelwano esibhaliwe phakathi kwezinhlangothi ezimbili umthetho ozosisekela.
gloss.sow.text: Idokhumenti ebeka ngqo ukuthi yimuphi umsebenzi ozokwenziwa, nini nangemali engakanani.
gloss.fixedprice.text: Intengo evunyelwene yawo wonke umsebenzi, noma uthatha isikhathi esingakanani.
gloss.tm.text: Ukukhokhela amahora asetshenzwe ngempela nezinto ezisetshenziswe ngempela, esikhundleni sentengo emisiwe.
gloss.invoice.text: Ibhili elicela inkokhelo yomsebenzi owenziwe noma izimpahla ezinikeziwe.
gloss.lockin.text: Uma ukusuka kumhlinzeki kunzima noma kubiza kangangokuba uzithola ubotshelwe kuye.
gloss.servicecredit.text: Imali ebuyiswayo noma isaphulelo osithola uma umhlinzeki ehluleka ukufeza i-SLA yakhe.
tour.firststeps.title: Izinyathelo zokuqala
tour.firststeps.text: Uhlu olufushane lokuqalisa: yenza iphrojekthi, engeza ikhadi, mema umngane. Ngayinye iziphawula yona uma uyenza. Lufihle uma usuyazi indlela.
tour.firststeps.short: Izinto ezimbalwa zokuqala ongazenza. Ziziphawula zona.
tour.firststeps.why: Ukwenza ngayinye kanye kuyindlela esheshayo yokufunda ibhodi.
tour.help.title: Usizo uma uludinga
tour.help.text: ❓ Usizo lunesigaba Ukuqala, lolu hambo futhi, kanye ne-📖 uhlu lwamagama, oluchaza amagama ochwepheshe ngolimi olulula. Yenza iphrojekthi noma engeza ikhadi ukuze uqale.
tour.help.short: ❓ Usizo: Ukuqala, uhambo futhi kanye ne-📖 uhlu lwamagama.
tour.chat.text.noai: Xoxa nabangane bakho lapha. Vula ingxoxo yomngane ukuze umshayele, ngevidiyo nokwabelana ngesikrini.
tour.chat.why.noai: Khulumani ngezinto eduze nomsebenzi, ngaphandle kwenye i-app.
help.thanks.chilled: Amakholi, ukwabelana ngesikrini, izimpendulo, ukusabela namachashaza okuthayipha kuvela ku-{name}. Siyabonga!
help.thanks.livekit: Amakholi asebenza ku-{name}, iseva yamakholi yomthombo ovulekile.

noteam.line: Alikabi bikho iqembu lapha, ngakho akukho okusetshenzwayo.
noteam.nofolder: Iqembu lidinga ifolda yokusebenzela, ngakho akukho okusetshenzwayo okwamanje.

claim.share.fresh: Lena ikhophi yakho entsha: akukho lutho luka-{name} kuyo, futhi u-{name} ubona igama lakho lokuqala kuphela.
claim.share.name: Ngubani igama lakho?
claim.share.linked: Wena no-{name} senibangani ku-Imilayezo manje: bingelela ngaphansi kwe-Abangani.
claim.share.nolink: Cela u-{name} akuthumelele isimemo sobungane, ukuze nithumelane imilayezo ngaphansi kwe-Abangani.
