claim.err.full: Le khophi isabelwe kakhulu kakade, ngakho ayikwazi ukungenisa umuntu omusha. Cela umuntu okunike yona isimemo sakho siqu.
sample.svc.offers: Ikhasi le-RSVP lapho izivakashi zisho ukuthi ziyeza yini
sample.inc.d: Kwenziwe nje, ukuze uzijwayeze. Izivakashi ezivula isixhumanisi se-RSVP zibona “Kukhona okungahambanga kahle”, ngakho akekho ongasho ukuthi uyeza. Landela izinyathelo ze-🎓 Zama kuleli khadi: akukho okuphuka ngempela futhi ayisetshenziswa i-AI.
sample.inc.say: Izivakashi ezintathu zithumele imilayezo: kusukela namhlanje ekuseni ikhasi le-RSVP lithi “Kukhona okungahambanga kahle”.
sample.inc.major: 🚨 Ukuzijwayeza: manje lesi yisigameko esikhulu. Kusevisi yangempela ukuhlangana kuyavulwa, isikhulumeli esilindile siyavuswa futhi uthola isaziso esisodwa. Lapha akekho ovuswayo. Okulandelayo: kulungise bese uvala ikhadi.
sample.inc.pir: 📝 Ukuzijwayeza: bhala wena ukubuyekezwa kwangemva kwesigameko, efomini elikuleli khadi: ukulandelana kwezenzakalo, okusize nokufanele kushintshwe.
sample.inc.rbgo: 📖 Ukuzijwayeza: kuphrojekthi yangempela le runbook manje ibizogcinwa njenge-{file} kufolda yephrojekthi. Isampula ayinayo ifolda, ngakho akukho okubhaliwe.
gloss.ci.text: Into eyodwa isevisi yakho encike kuyo, njengeseva, isizinda, isitifiketi, ukhiye noma umhlinzeki. 🗂️ Izinto izibala ngesevisi ngayinye, ukuze ubone ukuthi isigameko sithinta ini nokuthi yini edinga ukuvuselelwa noma isipele.
gloss.expiry.also: izinsuku zokuphelelwa yisikhathi,ukuphelelwa yisikhathi,ukuqapha ukuphelelwa,expiry date,expiry dates,expiry
gloss.expiry.text: Usuku into eyeka ukusebenza ngalo ngaphandle kokuba ivuselelwe, njengesitifiketi sokuphepha sewebhusayithi noma ikheli layo lewebhu. I-AI-gile ibheka lezi zinsuku yenze ikhadi elilodwa lokuvuselela ngalinye ezinsukwini ezingu-30 ngaphambili, ukuze kungabikho okuphela ngokungalindelekile.
gloss.desk.text: Lapho imibuzo nemibiko evela kubantu abasebenzisa isevisi yakho ingena khona. I-AI-gile ihlela ngamunye ube yisicelo, isigameko noma umcabango, futhi ikutshele uma kubukeka kufana nokuthile osekubikiwe.
gloss.svcrequest.text: Umuntu ocela okuthile okujwayelekile, njenge-akhawunti entsha noma usizo oluncane, kunokuba abike ukuthi kukhona okuphukile. Silinda ithuba laso; isigameko siza kuqala.
gloss.svcreview.text: Ukubheka emuva enyangeni eyodwa yesevisi: izigameko ezivuliwe nezilungisiwe, ukuthi abantu bathole impendulo ngokushesha kangakanani, isikhathi sokusebenza nama-token asetshenzisiwe. Ukubuyekezwa kwenyanga kukukhombisa lokhu kusevisi ngayinye.
gloss.accessreview.text: Ukuhlola njalo ezinsukwini ezingu-90 ukuthi ngubani osenelungelo lokungena: izixhumanisi zokwabelana, izindima zabangani namaphasiwedi nokhiye abagciniwe. Ugcina noma ususe ngamunye, ukuze ukufinyelela okudala kungahlali.
gloss.improvements.text: Konke ithimba elinqume ukukwenza kangcono, endaweni eyodwa: iziphakamiso ze-retro, izenzo zokubuyekeza nokulungiswa kwezinkinga, ngakunye nesimo sakhona. Kuthole ngaphansi kwe-📈 Ukuthuthukiswa.

gloss.tokencap.text: Umkhawulo wenyanga wama-token izikhulumeli zesevisi ezingawasebenzisa. Ku-80% uthola isexwayiso; ku-100% umsebenzi wazo wangemuva ulinda kuze kube yinyanga ezayo noma uze ukhuphule umkhawulo.
dc.setup.intro: Khuluma nesikhulumeli usuka ku-Discord, kalula njengasebhodini. Kuyazikhethela.
dc.guide.1.html: Iya ku-discord.com/developers/applications bese uchofoza u-New Application. Yiqambe ngegama lesikhulumeli.
dc.guide.2.html: Vula u-Bot kumenyu engakwesobunxele, bese u-Reset Token futhi uyikopishe. Ikhonjiswa kanye kuphela.

guide.inc.hi:
- **Isigameko** 🔥 yikhadi lokuthi “kuphukile manje”. Leqa ulayini futhi linomphetho obomvu.
- Ukulivala kubuza imibuzo emithathu emifushane: kwenzekeni, kungani, yini esizoyishintsha.
- Uma into efanayo iphinda iphuka, qoqa izigameko ngaphansi **kwenkinga** 🧩 eyodwa enembangela eyinhloko nendlela yesikhashana.
- Ukulungisa kwangempela kudlula esicelweni sokushintsha.
guide.inc.steps:
1. Vula isigameko: **Ikhadi elisha**, uhlobo **🔥 isigameko**.
2. Qala ngokukulungisa. Sebenzisa indlela yesikhashana uma ikhadi lenkinga linayo.
3. Lihambise ku-kuphelile. Gcwalisa **Kwenzekeni**, **Kungani**, **Esikushintshayo**, bese **Kuphelile**.
4. Kwake kwenzeka phambilini? Cela umholi wakho aqoqe izigameko ngaphansi kwekhadi **🧩 inkinga** (imiyalo ingaphansi kuka-*Okwezikhulumeli*).
5. Ikhadi lenkinga likhombisa **Imbangela eyinhloko**, **Indlela yesikhashana**, izigameko nesicelo sokushintsha.
6. Izigameko zakamuva zijoyina inkinga efanayo; ikhadi lizibala zonke.
7. Vula isicelo sokushintsha sokulungisa. Inkinga ihlala ivuliwe kuze kube yilapho lolo shintsho seluqediwe.
guide.inc.full:
- **Kungani kubalulekile:** isigameko simayelana nokubuyela esimweni esijwayelekile ngokushesha. Inkinga imayelana nembangela. Uma uzixuba, uzocisha umlilo ofanayo kaninginingi.
- **Isigameko:** ukuhlaziywa kwesigameko akusoli muntu. Kusho ukuthi kwenzekeni, kungani, nokuthi yini ezoshintsha ukuze kungaphindi. Ingozi esohlwini lwezingozi uma yenzeka ikuvulela isigameko.
- **Inkinga:** imbangela eyodwa, izigameko eziningi. Imbangela eyinhloko yisizathu esingemuva kwesizathu (hhayi “iseva ibingasebenzi” kodwa “iskripthi se-deploy seqa ukuhlola”). Indlela yesikhashana yilokho noma ubani akwenzayo kuze kuphume ukulungisa.
- **Ukuxhuma:** isigameko singesenkinga eyodwa. Ukuxhuma kubonakala kuwo womabili amakhadi. Ukusixhuma kwenye inkinga kusihambisela khona.
- **Isicelo sokushintsha:** ukulungisa wushintsho njengolunye, olunesizathu, ingozi nendlela yokubuyela emuva. Inkinga ihlala ivuliwe kuze kube yilapho lolo shintsho seluqediwe.
- **Imikhuba emihle:** bheka izinkinga ezivuliwe ku-retro ngayinye; uma izigameko ezintathu zinembangela efanayo, yenza inkinga; gcina izindlela zesikhashana zimfushane ngokwanele ukuthi zilandelwe ngisho noma ucindezelekile.
guide.inc.agents:

- Yenza inkinga: `aigile problem <proj> add "Deploys break the site" --incidents AIG-1,AIG-2`
- Imbangela nendlela yesikhashana: `aigile problem <proj> AIG-9 --cause "..." --workaround "..."`
- Xhuma isigameko sakamuva: `aigile problem <proj> AIG-9 link AIG-12`
- Xhuma isicelo sokushintsha: `aigile problem <proj> AIG-9 --change AIG-20`
guide.svc.hi:
- Tshela ibhodi ukuthi yimaphi amaphrojekthi **amasevisi**: anikezani, ubani owasebenzisayo nekheli lawo lewebhu. Bese ibhodi likuqaphela lelo kheli.
- Uma isevisi iyeka ukuphendula, ibhodi livula **isigameko esisodwa** ngokwalo. Ikhadi elilinda isikhathi eside kakhulu likhombisa iwashi elibomvu ⏰ “phendula ngaphambi kuka”.
- Isigameko esibi ngempela sithola inkinobho ethi **🚨 Okukhulu**: ukuchofoza okukodwa kuvusa isikhulumeli esifanele futhi kukutshele. Ikhasi lesimo lomphakathi likhombisa abangane ukuthi kwenzekani.
- Okufundayo kuyagcinwa: **🧩 Amaphutha aziwayo**, **📖 Ama-runbook** (indlela yokulungisa u-X) kanye **📝 Ukubuyekezwa kwangemva kwesigameko** esigamekweni ngasinye esikhulu.
- Qaphela **🗂️ Izinto** isevisi yakho emi phezu kwazo (izinsuku zokuphelelwa yisikhathi, izipele), **🔐 Ukubuyekezwa kokufinyelela** njalo ezinsukwini ezingu-90, **🚀 Ukukhishwa**, uhlu lwe-**📈 Ukuthuthukiswa** futhi, kanye ngenyanga, **📆 Ukubuyekeza** (nomkhawulo wama-token wenyanga uma uthanda).
guide.svc.steps:
1. Ebhodini lephrojekthi chofoza **🎨 Look**. Ewindini elithi **Izilungiselelo zephrojekthi** thola isigaba esithi **🛎️ Isevisi**. Maka **Le phrojekthi iyisevisi** bese ugcwalisa ukuthi inikezani, ubani oyisebenzisayo nekheli layo lewebhu.
2. Khetha **Isikhulumeli esilindile** (ngokuzenzakalelayo ngumholi) bese umaka **Esidlangalaleni** uma abangane bengayibona ekhasini lesimo. Uma uthanda, thayipha **umkhawulo wama-token wenyanga** ukuze iphrojekthi eyodwa ingadli sonke isabelomali. Chofoza **Gcina**.
3. Bheka ichashaza lephrojekthi ku-**Ikhaya**: okuluhlaza kusho ukuthi ikheli liyaphendula. Uma liyeka ukuphendula, ikhadi lesigameko livela ngokwalo.
4. Vula lelo khadi lesigameko. Kubi? Chofoza **🚨 Okukhulu**. Chofoza **Qeda isigameko esikhulu** uma sekuphelile.
5. Amakhadi alinda isikhathi eside kakhulu akhombisa u-⏰ obomvu. Wavule kuqala. Isihlungi sebhokisi lokungenayo esithi **Idesiki: izigameko** sikhombisa kuphela izigameko ezivela kubangane nasefomini lempendulo.
6. Chofoza **⋯ Okuningi** ebhodini, bese **🗂️ Izinto**. Chofoza **+ Engeza into** kuseva ngayinye, isizinda, isitifiketi, ukhiye, i-repo noma umhlinzeki. Engeza usuku lokuphelelwa yisikhathi futhi, kudatha, lapho yenziwa khona isipele nokuthi kangaki. Chofoza **Kwenziwe isipele namhlanje** ngemva kwesipele ngasinye.
7. Ekhadini lesigameko bheka ibhokisi elithi **📖 Ama-runbook**: libala imiyalelo efanele. Chofoza **Vula** ukuze ufunde eyodwa.
8. Ngemva kokuba isigameko esikhulu siphelile, ikhadi laso likhombisa **📝 Ukubuyekezwa kwangemva kwesigameko**. Funda ukulandelana kwezenzakalo, bese uchofoza **Yenza ikhadi** eduze kwento ngayinye okufanele ishintshwe.
9. Chofoza **⋯ Okuningi**, bese **🧩 Amaphutha aziwayo** ukuze ubone izinkinga ezinendlela yesikhashana. Chofoza **🚀 Ukukhishwa**, thayipha igama elifana no-v1.3 bese uchofoza **🚀 Ukukhishwa okusha** ukuze uqoqe amakhadi aqediwe abe ngamanothi. **↩ Buyela emuva** ivula ikhadi lohlu lokuhlola lokuhlehlisa.
10. Kanye ngenyanga chofoza **⋯ Okuningi**, bese **📆 Ukubuyekeza**: sebenzisa **← Kudlule** kanye **Kamuva →** ukuze ushintshe inyanga, kanye **✍️ Isifinyezo** ukuze uthole isifinyezo semigqa emibili esivela kusikhulumeli esilindile.
11. Chofoza **⋯ Okuningi**, bese **📈 Ukuthuthukiswa** (kukhona nakumenyu ethi **❓ Usizo**) ukuze ubone imibono ye-retro, izenzo zokubuyekeza nokulungiswa kwezinkinga ohlwini olulodwa. Ku-**Ukusetha** chofoza **Qalisa ukubuyekezwa kokufinyelela manje** ukuze ubone ukuthi ubani ongangena, bese **Gcina** noma **Susa** ngamunye.
guide.svc.full:
- **Imininingwane yesevisi:** ku-**🎨 Look**, **Izilungiselelo zephrojekthi**, **🛎️ Isevisi** usho ukuthi iphrojekthi inikezani, kubani, ekhelini liphi lewebhu nokuthi ubani olindile. Amaphrojekthi owamakayo kuphela abalwa njengamasevisi.
- **Ichashaza lokusebenza:** njalo emizuzwini embalwa ibhodi libuza ikheli lewebhu ukuthi liyaphila yini. Okuluhlaza kusho ukuthi kulungile; okubomvu kusho ukuthi aliphendulanga. Ukwehluleka kathathu kulandelana kuvula isigameko esisodwa, hhayi inqwaba, futhi ukuphawula kusho ukuthi libuye nini (“Liyasebenza futhi ngemva kwemizuzu engu-N”).
- **Phendula ngaphambi kuka ⏰:** uhlobo ngalunye lwekhadi lunesikhathi sokuphendula (isigameko cishe ihora, isicelo somngane izinsuku ezimbalwa, i-bug cishe isonto). Amakhadi asephuzile aba bomvu futhi isifinyezo sansuku zonke siyawabala. Lezi yizinhloso, hhayi izithembiso.
- **🚨 Okukhulu:** okwesigameko esilimaza abasebenzisi abaningi noma esibeka imali noma idatha engozini. Ukuchofoza okukodwa kuvula ukuhlangana, kuvuse isikhulumeli esilindile, kukuthumelele isaziso esisodwa futhi kucele ukuphawula okuthi “Status:” njalo ngemizuzu engu-30.
- **Ikhasi lesimo:** ikhasi lomphakathi likhombisa isevisi ngayinye yomphakathi ngokuluhlaza, okusawolintshi noma okubomvu kanye nomugqa wesimo wakamuva. Alikaze likhombise umbhalo wekhadi, kuphela umugqa okhethwe nguwe noma isikhulumeli.
- **Idesiki lesevisi:** imibiko evela kubangane nasefomini lempendulo ihlelwa ibe **Isicelo**, **Isigameko** noma **Umcabango**. Isihlungi sebhokisi lokungenayo (**Idesiki: zonke**, **Idesiki: izicelo** njalonjalo) sikhombisa uhlobo olulodwa. Umbiko obukeka ufana nekhadi osunalo uthi “kubukeka kufana no-AIG-12” nenkinobho ethi **Xhuma**.
- **🧩 Amaphutha aziwayo:** inkinga enembangela eyaziwayo nendlela yesikhashana kodwa engakalungiswa. Abalwa ngephrojekthi ngayinye nawo wonke amaphrojekthi, futhi angena esifinyezweni sesikhulumeli ngasinye, ukuze kungabikho ophenya kabili.
- **📖 Ama-runbook:** amanothi amafushane esinyathelo ngesinyathelo okuthi ilungiswa kanjani into. Ikhadi lesigameko likhombisa lawo ahambisana nesihloko salo. Ngemva kokubuyekezwa, isikhulumeli singaphakamisa i-runbook entsha bese uthi Hamba noma Hhayi okwamanje.
- **📝 Ukubuyekezwa kwangemva kwesigameko:** ngemva kokuba isigameko esikhulu siphelile, isikhulumeli sibhala **Ukulandelana kwezenzakalo**, **Okusize** kanye **Okufanele kushintshwe**. Isenzo ngasinye siba yikhadi nge-**Yenza ikhadi**. Uma singekho isikhulumeli esikhululekile, uyabhala wena.
- **🗂️ Izinto:** uhlu lwezinto isevisi emi phezu kwazo, ne-**Uhlobo** (iseva, isizinda, isitifiketi, ukhiye, i-repo, umhlinzeki, okunye). Ngayinye ingaba nezixhumanisi zamakhadi noma amakheli ewebhu. Ukhiye uyigama lawo kuphela kusuka ku-Izimfihlo, hhayi ukhiye uqobo. Amakhadi esigameko nawokushintsha angakhombisa ukuthi **athinta** ini.
- **Ukuphelelwa yisikhathi nezipele:** nsuku zonke ibhodi lihlola izinsuku zokuphelelwa yisikhathi nobudala bezipele. Ikhadi livela ngaphambi kokuba okuthile kuphelelwe yisikhathi noma uma isipele sesidala kakhulu, futhi kanye ngenyanga ikhadi lokuhlola ukubuyisela likukhumbuza ukuthi isipele ongakaze uzame ukusibuyisela siyithemba nje.
- **Impilo yeseva:** ibhodi liqapha i-CPU, inkumbulo nediski kumaseva akho futhi livule ikhadi lokuthuthukisa ngaphambi kokuba agcwale.
- **🔐 Ukubuyekezwa kokufinyelela:** njalo ezinsukwini ezingu-90 ikhadi elilodwa libala izixhumanisi zokwabelana, izindima zabangane nezimfihlo ezigciniwe (amagama kuphela), ngakunye no-**Gcina** noma **Susa**. Kuqalise manje ku-**Ukusetha**.
- **🚀 Ukukhishwa:** ukukhishwa kuyiqoqo eliqanjwe igama lamakhadi aqediwe kusukela kokugcina, namanothi amafushane. **↩ Buyela emuva** ivula ikhadi lohlu lokuhlola elinezinyathelo zokuhlehlisa.
- **📈 Ukuthuthukiswa:** iziphakamiso ze-retro, izenzo zokubuyekeza nokulungiswa kwezinkinga ohlwini olulodwa, olungahlungwa ngephrojekthi, ukuze imibono emihle ingalahleki phakathi kwama-retro.
- **📆 Ukubuyekezwa kwenyanga:** ikhasi elilodwa ngesevisi ngayinye enyangeni eyodwa: izigameko ezivuliwe nezivaliwe, isikhathi esimaphakathi sokulungisa, amakhadi afinyelele inhloso yawo yesikhathi sokuphendula, isikhathi sokusebenza, ama-token asetshenzisiwe neziqongo zeseva. Kuvule ku-**⋯ Okuningi → 📆 Ukubuyekeza** noma ku-**Izilungiselelo zephrojekthi → Isevisi**.
- **Umkhawulo wama-token wenyanga:** ku-**Izilungiselelo zephrojekthi → Isevisi** ungabeka umkhawulo wenyanga wama-token. Ku-80% isifinyezo sansuku zonke siyakuxwayisa; ku-100% ukusebenza kwangemuva kwaleyo phrojekthi kulinda kuze kube yinyanga ezayo noma uze ukhuphule umkhawulo. Ukuvusa kwakho kusasebenza.
- **Imikhuba emihle:** qala ngokugcwalisa imininingwane yesevisi, gcina ikheli lewebhu lilungile, bheka ichashaza lesimo nsuku zonke, bhala ngesigameko ngasinye esikhulu futhi uhlole uhlu lokuthuthukiswa ngemva kwe-retro ngayinye, bese ufunda ukubuyekezwa kwenyanga inyanga isasha engqondweni.

guide.msg.hi:
- **💬 Imilayezo**, phezulu kumugqa ongakwesobunxele, igcina zonke izingxoxo zakho: abaholi bamaphrojekthi, abangane, amaqembu ezikhulumeli negumbi lokuhlangana lephrojekthi ngayinye. Izihlungi **🤖 Izikhulumeli**, **🙋 Abantu** kanye **🎥 Amagumbi okuhlangana** zikhombisa uhlobo olulodwa.
- **I-DM** yingxoxo eyimfihlo nomholi oyedwa noma umngane oyedwa. Izingxoxo nabangane zibethelwe endleleni nakule khompyutha.
- **Iqembu** libeka izikhulumeli ezimbili noma ngaphezulu engxoxweni eyodwa: bhala kanye, futhi ngasinye siyaphendula.
- Engxoxweni yomngane, **📞 Ikholi** iqala ikholi yezwi noma yevidiyo, ne-**🖥️ Yabelana ngesikrini**. Igumbi lokuhlangana lephrojekthi ngayinye linelalo **🎥 Joyina ikholi**.
- Imakrofoni noma ikhamera ivinjiwe? Yivumele kubha yekheli yesiphequluli. Ungakwazi ukulalela njalo.
guide.msg.steps:
1. Chofoza **💬 Imilayezo** phezulu kumugqa ongakwesobunxele. Khetha isihlungi ukuze ubone kuphela **🤖 Izikhulumeli**, **🙋 Abantu** noma **🎥 Amagumbi okuhlangana**.
2. Chofoza umholi wephrojekthi ukuze ukhulume ngqo nalelo thimba. Thayipha bese ucindezela u-Enter; umholi uphendula kuyo leyo ngxoxo.
3. Chofoza umngane ngaphansi kuka-**🙋 Abantu** ukuze uxoxe naye. Umngane uvela lapha uma esejoyine ngesimemo sakho.
4. Ukuze ubuze izikhulumeli eziningana ngesikhathi esisodwa, chofoza **＋ Iqembu elisha**, linike igama, maka izikhulumeli ezimbili noma ngaphezulu bese uchofoza **Dala**.
5. Engxoxweni yomngane chofoza **📞 Ikholi**. Umngane wakho ubona ukuthi uyashaya bese echofoza ukuze ajoyine. Sebenzisa **🔇 Thula**, **📷 Ikhamera ivuliwe** kanye **🖥️ Yabelana ngesikrini**, bese **Shiya ikholi** uma usuqedile.
6. Ngaphansi kuka-**🎥 Amagumbi okuhlangana**, vula igumbi lephrojekthi ukuze ukhulume nethimba layo lonke engxoxweni eyodwa. Chofoza **🎥 Joyina ikholi** ukuze uthole ikholi yayo yezwi noma yevidiyo.
7. Okokuqala, isiphequluli sicela imakrofoni: chofoza **Vumela**. Wenqabe ngephutha? Chofoza isithonjana ekuqaleni kwebha yekheli, vumela imakrofoni bese uphinda ushaya.
guide.msg.full:
- **Indawo eyodwa yazo zonke izingxoxo:** **💬 Imilayezo** ibala abaholi, abangane, amaqembu namagumbi okuhlangana ndawonye, okusha kuqala. Izihlungi zishintsha kuphela lokho okubonayo; akukho okuhanjiswayo noma okususwayo.
- **Abaholi:** iphrojekthi ngayinye inomholi. Ingxoxo naye iyindlela esheshayo kakhulu yokubuza lelo thimba okuthile ngaphandle kokwenza ikhadi. Impendulo ngayinye ingukusebenza kwesikhulumeli, ngakho isebenzisa ama-token.
- **Abangane:** umngane usebenzisa i-AI-gile yakhe. Ama-DM akho ahamba phakathi kwamabhodi enu omabili ebethelwe, futhi agcinwa ebethelwe nakule khompyutha. Izimpendulo, ukusabela namachashaza okuthayipha kusebenza njengakunoma iyiphi i-app yokuxoxa.
- **Amaqembu:** wena nezikhulumeli ezimbili noma ngaphezulu, ezivela kunoma iyiphi iphrojekthi. Umlayezo ngamunye owubhalayo uvusa ilungu ngalinye kanye ukuze liphendule, ngakho iqembu elikhulu lisebenzisa ama-token amaningi.
- **Amagumbi okuhlangana:** elilodwa ngephrojekthi ngayinye, nezikhulumeli zethimba layo njengamalungu, njalo kubuyekeziwe. Ikholi esegumbini lokuhlangana ingeyakho kuphela: abangane nezikhulumeli abakwazi ukuyijoyina.
- **Amakholi:** amakholi ezwi nawevidiyo asebenza ngokushesha ngeseva yamakholi ye-AI-gile uqobo, kuwe nakumngane wakho; akukho okufanele kusethwe. Ukuze usebenzise iseva yakho ye-LiveKit, vula **Ukusetha → Amakholi → Okuthuthukile**.
- **Ukwabelana ngesikrini:** ekholini chofoza **🖥️ Yabelana ngesikrini**; isiphequluli sibuza ukuthi yisiphi isikrini, iwindi noma ithebhu. Chofoza **🖥️ Misa ukwabelana** ukuze uyeke.
- **Imakrofoni, ikhamera nesipikha:** iphaneli yekholi inesikhethi sento ngayinye, siwusizo nge-headset noma ikhamera yesibili.
- **Uma imakrofoni noma ikhamera ingasebenzi:** “ivinjiwe” kusho ukuthi isiphequluli senqabile: kuvumele kubha yekheli. “Ayitholakalanga” kusho ukuthi akukho okuxhunyiwe noma okuvuliwe. “Isetshenziswa enye i-app” kusho ukuthi enye i-app yamakholi iyayibamba: vala leyo. Ungakwazi ukulalela njalo.
- **Ikholi enqamukayo:** uqala ubone “Kuyaxhunywa futhi…”. Uma iphela, hlola i-inthanethi yakho bese uphinda ushaya.
- **Imikhuba emihle:** sebenzisa iqembu noma igumbi lokuhlangana embuzweni oya kuzikhulumeli eziningana kunokuwukopisha, thula uma ungakhulumi, futhi wabelane ngewindi elilodwa kunesikrini sonke.
